name: Alala Amed Spa & Boutique
what_to_order: Foot Reflexology (60 min) — 100K IDR.
why_its_here: A day spa in Amed with 18 treatments on the list, from traditional massage to shirodhara and deep tissue. An hour of foot reflexology costs 100K IDR. Book by WhatsApp.
best_for: Foot reflexology when you've walked enough, or a three-hour reset
full_address: Jl. I Ketut Natih, Purwakerti, Kec. Abang, Kabupaten Karangasem, Bali 80852

name: Amed Roda Spa
what_to_order: Balinese Massage (60 min) — 170K IDR.
why_its_here: Amed Roda Spa is a day spa in Amed with 24 treatments, among them traditional massage, head massage and a body scrub. A 60-minute Balinese massage is 170K IDR, and you book by WhatsApp.
best_for: A head massage, or up to two hours of treatment in Amed
full_address: Amed, Karangasem Bali

name: Blue Earth Village
why_its_here: Facials, cupping and deep tissue are among the seven treatments at Blue Earth Village, a day spa in Amed. Bookings are taken by WhatsApp.
best_for: A cupping session or a facial, arranged by WhatsApp
full_address: Amed, Bali

name: Hotel Uyah Amed & Spa Resort
what_to_order: Traditional Full Body “Pijat” Massage (60 minutes) (60 min) — 120K IDR.
why_its_here: The spa at Hotel Uyah Amed & Spa Resort lists 32 treatments, from traditional massage to manicures and reflexology. An hour of the full-body pijat massage costs 120K IDR. Book on the hotel's own site.
best_for: A three-hour treatment, or reflexology for feet tired from walking
full_address: Jl. I Ketut Natih, Pantai Timur No. 801 Amed – Karangasem – Bali – Indonesia 80852

name: Palm Garden Spa
why_its_here: Palm Garden Spa, a day spa in Amed, keeps seven treatments on its list, including Balinese massage, a four-hands massage and a facial. Booking is on the spa's own site.
best_for: A four-hands massage or a facial in Amed

name: The Monkey Bar
what_to_order: nasi goreng; seafood pizza; burgers; cocktails; cold-pressed juices
why_its_here: Up in the hills of East Bali, this restaurant and bar is built around an infinity pool at Bella Kita Mountain Retreat. Valley views run toward the sea, and produce comes from the property's own farm. Entry is pay-and-swim, and it includes credit toward food.
best_for: A swim and lunch on an East Bali day trip, away from the southern crowds

name: Desa Wisata Penglipuran
why_its_here: Penglipuran is a traditional Bali Aga village in Bangli. Its houses are uniform and bamboo-roofed, and the main street is car-free.
best_for: A walk through traditional Balinese village architecture, as an easy stop between Kintamani and south Bali

name: Kedisan Kintamani
address: Oculus Bali Jalan Windu Sara, Kedisan, Kintamani, Bali 80652
why_its_here: Cafe in Oculus Bali Jalan Windu Sara, Bangli.
best_for: Travellers who want to check availability and reserve a table through Chope.
full_address: Oculus Bali Jalan Windu Sara, Kedisan, Kintamani, Bali 80652

name: Pura Kehen
why_its_here: Pura Kehen is Bangli's state temple, a multi-tiered terraced complex set into a hillside. Antique Chinese porcelain plates are set into its walls.
best_for: a quieter temple visit away from the main south-Bali circuit

name: SiSi GeGe Restaurant at Pramana Zahill
address: Jl. Raya Kintamani, Batur Sel., Kec. Kintamani, Kabupaten Bangli, Bali 80652
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Raya Kintamani in Bangli, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Unknown.
full_address: Jl. Raya Kintamani, Batur Sel., Kec. Kintamani, Kabupaten Bangli, Bali 80652

name: Tirta Padma (Tribhuwana Padma)
address: Tribhuwana Padma, Jalan Kedisan No. 28, Kintamani, Bali 80652
why_its_here: Tirta Padma is the restaurant at Tribhuwana Padma, a lakeside resort in Kedisan, Kintamani, with views of Mount Batur and the highlands around it.
best_for: A lakeside meal on a planned Kintamani visit
not_for: A quick bite on a tight south-Bali beach schedule, as it sits up in Kintamani
full_address: Tribhuwana Padma, Jalan Kedisan No. 28, Kintamani, Bali 80652

name: Tourism Village Tembuku
why_its_here: Rice terraces and forest surround Tembuku, a village in Bangli. It is home to Tukad Cepung waterfall, roughly 8km from Bangli town, where water falls through a narrow rock crevice about 15 metres high.
best_for: A waterfall away from the main tourist circuit, or traditional cooking and craft demonstrations

name: Tourism Village Undisan
why_its_here: Undisan, a traditional village in Bangli, is about 90 minutes from Ngurah Rai airport or 45 minutes from Ubud. Its traditions include matekap, ploughing rice fields with oxen, and gold-and-silver flower craftwork. Air Terjun Tangkup waterfall is roughly a 45-minute walk from the main road.
best_for: Rice-field ploughing and craft demonstrations, or a waterfall walk away from the tourist trail

name: 12 Kitchen and Wine
address: Berawa / Pantai Berawa
why_its_here: An all-day restaurant and wine bar on Jalan Pantai Berawa, open 8am to midnight daily. Its own site describes grill cooking with local ingredients, a breakfast service and a large wine list. You can book through the website or WhatsApp, but you don't have to.
best_for: A date or an unhurried dinner over wine
full_address: Berawa / Pantai Berawa

name: 12 Urban Cafe - Breakfast & Dinner | Movie night | Cocktail Bar Canggu
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan No.12c, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
price_anchor: Mains 95-380K · Prices exclude 10% tax and 7% service
what_to_order: Urban Beef Burger (140K); Tuna Tataki (150K); San Sebastian Cheese Cake (75K)
why_its_here: A cafe and cocktail bar on Jalan Pantai Batu Mejan, open 8am to midnight daily. The main menu goes from pasta and risotto to schnitzel and seafood, with a rib eye steak. Brunch, the bar and wine cocktails have their own menus. Book through the site or Chope.
best_for: A long menu at one address: breakfast from 8am, steaks and pasta until midnight
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan No.12c, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: 7AM Bakers Umalas
address: Umalas / Kerobokan / Umalas
why_its_here: On Jalan Bumbak Dauh, 7AM Bakers runs its Umalas outlet as a bakery and all-day cafe. The brand has seven outlets across Bali and Jakarta, and this one's page describes freshly baked artisan pastries, specialty coffee and international dishes. Tables book online; GoFood and GrabFood deliver.
best_for: A bakery-cafe sit-down in Umalas: pastries, coffee and all-day food
not_for: A late dinner: it keeps daytime hours and closes in the evening
full_address: Umalas / Kerobokan / Umalas

name: Adda Yoga
price_anchor: Drop-in 160K tourist visa / 110K KITAS / 80K Indonesian · 12-class pack 1,300K · 30 days 2,000K
what_to_order: Sound Healing; Kundalini Activation; Cacao Ceremony
why_its_here: A yoga studio above the Awan co-working space on Jalan Kayu Manis in Canggu. Classes run from vinyasa and ashtanga to hatha, yin and restorative, with pranayama and meditation alongside sound healing and kundalini. The studio also runs 200- and 300-hour teacher trainings.
best_for: A walk-in class, with drop-in rates tiered by tourist visa, KITAS or Indonesian ID
not_for: Booking or paying online: you register and pay at the counter

name: Adventures Bike Rental Bali
what_to_order: Yamaha Fazzio — 125K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Vehicle rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers motorbikes and cars. Yamaha Fazzio starts at 125K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.

name: Air Seseh Recovery Club
why_its_here: A wellness centre in Canggu, Air Seseh Recovery Club has six things on its list, a sauna among them. Book on the club's own site.
best_for: A sauna at a recovery club in Canggu
full_address: Bali, Indonesia

name: Alam Wellness Bali
why_its_here: Alam Wellness Bali, a wellness spa in Canggu, has nine treatments, among them traditional massage, a body scrub and a facial. Book through its own site.
best_for: A body scrub or a facial in Canggu
full_address: Pererenan, Bali

name: Aliya Salon and Day Spa
price_anchor: $ · The Aliya Full Body Massage 60 min 195K
what_to_order: The Aliya Full Body Massage (60 min) — 195K IDR.
why_its_here: At Aliya, a salon and day spa in Canggu, the full body massage is 195K IDR for 60 minutes. The list covers traditional massage and reflexology, and you book through Fresha.
best_for: Reflexology for tired feet after a day of walking
full_address: Jalan Umalas I No. 10, Bali

name: Alma Spa
why_its_here: Spa in Canggu. The published treatment list runs to 8 items — Spa Package, Balinese Massage and Aromatherapy. Booking runs through Fresha.
best_for: Tired feet after a day of walking.
full_address: Jalan Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Bali

name: Alma Tapas Bar at Canggu
address: Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
price_anchor: Tapas 35-265K · 10% government tax and 6.5% service not included
what_to_order: Patatas Bravas (75K); Pulpo a la Plancha (145K); Carrilleras de Ternera (125K)
why_its_here: A Spanish tapas bar on Jalan Pantai Berawa, serving from 3pm daily, with food until 10.30pm and drinks until 11.30pm. The February 2026 menu goes from jamon and charcuterie to plancha seafood, beef cheeks and tartares, with separate wine and bar lists. A second Alma is at Pantai Bingin in Uluwatu.
best_for: Shared plates and wine over a long evening, or a small group grazing from 3pm
not_for: Breakfast or lunch: the Berawa site opens at 3pm
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: AMAVI Canggu Bali
address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.9, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: The menu at AMAVI goes from nasi goreng and sate ayam to Angus ribeye and pizza. It's a restaurant and bar lounge on Jl. Pantai Berawa, run on a Mediterranean concept, with a pool and rice field views.
best_for: Long lunches by the pool with a rice field view

name: Ameline Beauty & Spa
why_its_here: Ameline Beauty & Spa is a spa in Canggu with 20 treatments. Hot stone sits on the list next to traditional and Balinese massage, and you book on the spa's own site.
best_for: Hot stone, or a Balinese massage if you'd rather

name: AMO Spa
what_to_order: Balinese Massage (60 min) — 500K IDR.
why_its_here: Four treatments make up the list at AMO Spa, a day spa in Canggu, including Balinese massage, a Balinese boreh and a Javanese lulur. An hour of Balinese massage costs 500K IDR.
best_for: A Balinese boreh or a Javanese lulur in Canggu

name: AMO Spa Canggu
address: Batu Bolong / Canggu
what_to_order: Relax Me massage (60/90 min); AMO Baths hot-cold circuit; hydrafacial
why_its_here: A Batu Bolong wellness spa, open since 2008, that pairs traditional Balinese treatments with AMO Baths. The baths are a self-guided recovery circuit: sauna, ice bath and mineral soak. There are clinical facials too, and a cold-pressed juice cafe.
best_for: A slow, personalized massage or facial, or the hot-cold AMO Baths circuit
not_for: A quick 30-minute treatment — sessions are built for an unhurried pace.
full_address: Batu Bolong / Canggu

name: Amplitude Skate & Bike Park
price_anchor: Skate school 500K/person for 1.5hr · Private 1,700K for 4 sessions · Board hire, tax and service included · Park entry fee not published online
what_to_order: Regular Class 1.5hr (500K); Group 4 Class (1,500K); Private Class, 4 sessions (1,700K)
why_its_here: A 3000 square metre concrete skatepark in Kerobokan. It has a street course and a bowl park with three bowls, the largest an Olympic-size 10ft. Its own site welcomes skateboards, kickboards, cruisers and inline skates. The on-site school runs 1.5-hour group and private lessons from age four, boards included.
best_for: Learning to skate from age 4, or a session in a 3000m2 bowl and street park
not_for: A lesson for anyone under 4, or a booking you may cancel, since lessons start at age 4, are booked ahead and are non-refundable

name: Artisan – Pererenan
address: Jl. Munduk Kedungu No.5, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: Modern Italian cooking in Pererenan. The fourth Artisan outlet on the island, after Uluwatu, Ungasan and Bingin. Golden risotto with grilled prawn, and gnocchi with duck and porcini ragu.
best_for: A sit-down Italian dinner in Pererenan

name: Ashe Grill & Bar
address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.156, Canggu, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Bali, 80351
price_anchor: Per person 100-250K (Chope price range); no dish prices published
what_to_order: 36 HR Bone-in Short Ribs; Grilled Octopus
why_its_here: Ashe runs a wood-fired grill and bar on Jl. Pantai Pererenan, open evenings only. It opened in December 2025 with a kitchen built, by its own account, around live fire and Global South cooking traditions. The name is a Yoruba concept meaning life force.
best_for: Late dinners of wood-fired grill cooking on the Pererenan beach road
not_for: Lunch: it serves dinner only, and the kitchen opens at 5pm
full_address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.156, Canggu, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Bali, 80351

name: AT06
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan No.6, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Restaurant, coworking space and gym on one site in Canggu. European-Asian menu with vegetarian and vegan options. The gym has a cold plunge and a jacuzzi. Rebranded from Kajan Eatery in September 2024.
best_for: A work morning and a gym session in the same place

name: Atlas Beach Club
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa near Finns
price_anchor: Day pass 300K - includes welcome drink, pool access, towel hire
why_its_here: A large beachfront complex on Jl. Pantai Berawa. It runs four venues on one site: a beach club, the Super Club, a wellness club and a padel club. Its own website calls it the world's biggest beach club; we have not checked that. You enter on a day pass, and daybeds and sofas are booked separately.
best_for: A big, lively day out with a group, or sunset drinks in a party crowd
not_for: A small, quiet or intimate evening
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa near Finns

name: Aunty Ji's
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.83, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
what_to_order: Vada pav; a curry with naan; weekend brunch (Sat-Sun 11am-5pm)
why_its_here: Aunty Ji's, a Mumbai-inspired Indian kitchen on Batu Bolong, cooks from family aunty recipes. Expect curries, biryani, naan and street food such as vada pav. It stays open to midnight and delivers through GoFood and GrabFood.
best_for: A craving for Indian comfort food, from curries and biryani to vada pav, or a weekend brunch
not_for: A quiet meal. The room is casual and built around sharing plates
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.83, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Babi Guling Men Agus
why_its_here: A roadside babi guling warung on Jl. Raya Canggu. Babi guling is Balinese spit-roast pork, normally served over rice with sides.
best_for: Budget roadside babi guling on Jl. Raya Canggu; a fast, no-frills lunch

name: Babi Guling Men Lari
why_its_here: A babi guling warung in the Canggu area, operating as a branch of Men Lari in Mengwi. Babi guling is Balinese spit-roast pork, usually served over rice with sides.
best_for: A Canggu branch of the Mengwi babi guling warung Men Lari; an everyday pork lunch

name: Babi Guling Sari Kembar 99
why_its_here: A babi guling warung in Canggu trading under the Sari Kembar 99 name, which appears on several outlets around Badung and Denpasar. Babi guling is Balinese spit-roast pork, usually served over rice with sides.
best_for: A plate of babi guling, Balinese spit-roast pork, in Canggu

name: BAKED Pererenan
address: Badung / Pererenan
why_its_here: The Pererenan branch of BAKED., an artisanal bakehouse and specialty-coffee brand with several locations around Bali. It is on Jl. Pantai Pererenan, and its website describes gourmet breads and laminated pastries from breakfast through brunch to lunch.
best_for: Morning brunch, or a pastry-and-coffee stop on the Pererenan beach road
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: BAKED. Berawa
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa / Semat
why_its_here: One of several BAKED. bakehouses in Bali, this one on Jl. Raya Semat in Berawa (Tibubeneng) pairs artisanal baking with specialty coffee. The brand's site lists gourmet breads and laminated pastries for breakfast, brunch and lunch.
best_for: A morning meet-up over brunch, coffee and pastries
not_for: Dinner, because it closes at 7pm
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa / Semat

name: Bali Barber Canggu
address: Canggu
why_its_here: The Canggu branch of the Bali Barber chain, a barber for men. It does scissor cuts, clipper fades, beard work and classic hot-towel shaves.
best_for: Men after a walk-in cut, fade or shave in central Canggu
full_address: Canggu

name: Bali Buda Canggu
address: Canggu/Berawa
what_to_order: Bali Buda Bowl; Bibimbap; Austin Heartbeet Smoothie
why_its_here: Bali Buda has been on the island for over 25 years; its Canggu branch is an organic wholefoods cafe and shop. The menu covers breakfasts, bowls, salads and mains, plus bakery items and a list of juices and smoothies.
best_for: A wholefoods brunch or lunch with vegan, gluten-free and paleo options marked, then a raid on the organic shop
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

name: Bali Climbing Bouldering Gym
why_its_here: Bouldering gym and cafe at Kima Surf in Canggu. Routes from beginner to expert, plus free weights, bars, rings and ropes. Shoes and chalk are on site, kids classes run, and routes reset often.
best_for: Climbing on a day the surf is flat
not_for: A Sunday session - it opens Monday to Saturday

name: Bali Dream Villa Resort Echo Beach Canggu
what_to_order: Sweet Couple Dinner — 1500K IDR.
why_its_here: Bali Dream Villa Resort Echo Beach Canggu has a resort spa with six items, among them a couple massage and a traditional massage. Book on the resort's own site.
best_for: Couples, with a couple massage on the list

name: Bali MMA
address: Jalan Raya Padonan No.6, Canggu, Badung, Bali
price_text: Daily Pass Rp300,000 IDR Rp300,000
why_its_here: On Jalan Raya Padonan, Bali MMA runs a combat-sports gym for all levels, kids classes included. Boxing, Muay Thai, BJJ, no-gi grappling and MMA sparring run daily: 6am-10pm on weekdays, 7am-6pm at weekends. There's a weight room, an ice bath and a sauna.
best_for: A fight-training session at any level on a day pass, from 240K
not_for: A low-impact workout — sparring and grappling sessions get physical fast.
full_address: Jalan Raya Padonan No.6, Canggu, Badung, Bali

name: Bali Mutia Car Rental
what_to_order: Suzuki Jimny — 72K IDR 24 Jam.
why_its_here: Car rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers cars. Suzuki Jimny starts at 72K IDR 24 Jam. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A family or group needing a car, not just a scooter.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.
full_address: Jl. Merta Ayu Gang Buntu No. 1A, Kerobokan Kelod, Seminyak, Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80237, Indonesia

name: Bali Padel Academy
price_anchor: Court 150K/60min, 195K/90min, 280K/120min per person · Racket 50K · 1hr lesson 1.2-1.4M solo, 375-500K pp in a four · Recovery Area 70K on Playtomic wallet, 130K otherwise
what_to_order: Court hire 60 min (150K); Academy lesson, 1 hour; Recovery Area sauna and ice bath
why_its_here: A padel centre on Jalan Babakan Kubu in Canggu, open 7am to 11pm daily except Nyepi. Courts book through the Playtomic app, and there are one-hour coached lessons and a recovery area with a sauna and ice bath. Its own site calls it the international headquarters of the NOX Future Academy.
best_for: A coached padel hour, or a game followed by the sauna and ice bath
not_for: Plans that might change: cancelling inside 24h carries a 50% fee

name: Bali Serene Nature
why_its_here: Bali Serene Nature, a day spa in Canggu, has ten treatments, from a facial to traditional and Balinese massage. Book on its own site.
best_for: A facial, with traditional and Balinese massage too

name: Bambou Café & Lagree Cemagi
address: Cemagi / Mengwi / Cemagi / Mengening
price_anchor: Espresso 20K · Sourdough 35K · Eggs Rancheros 85K · Burger 115-125K · Grilled Fish Bali Style 150K · Plus 10% government tax and 5% service charge
what_to_order: Grilled Fish Bali Style (150K); Eggs Rancheros (85K); Electrolyte Bambou (40K)
why_its_here: A cafe on Jl. Pantai Mengening in Cemagi for coffee, brunch and dinner, with a Lagree reformer studio on site. On Instagram the venue is Coffee & Lagree; the studio trades as Kysko Studio Bali and takes class bookings through ClassPass. The cafe takes walk-ins and phone bookings.
best_for: Coffee after a Lagree class, or a sit-down brunch or dinner in Cemagi
full_address: Cemagi / Mengwi / Cemagi / Mengening

name: Bar Vera Bistro & Wine Bar
address: Pererenan / Pantai Pererenan
price_anchor: Snacks 35-240K · Small plates 35-90K · Mains 90-190K · Cocktails 150-180K · Wine by the glass 130-250K · Set menu 450K++ pp · +10% tax +7% service
what_to_order: Barramundi, pipirade, crème fraîche (120K); charcoal chicken, garlic parsley, bell pepper (140K); banoffee soufflé, coconut gelato, rum caramel
why_its_here: A 65-seat European bistro and wine bar on Jl. Pantai Pererenan, cooking produce-driven food with classic technique. The wine list is European-focused, cocktails and aperitifs have their own card, and lunch runs to breakfast plates and coffee. Bookings go through SevenRooms on the venue's site.
best_for: European wine and bistro plates over a date night or late dinner
full_address: Pererenan / Pantai Pererenan

name: Beach Boy Canggu
address: Canggu / Munduk Catu
price_anchor: Starters 75-135K · Pasta 115-125K · Mains 90-475K · Cocktails 129-149K · Bintang 39K · +10% tax +6% service
what_to_order: Black Angus Short Ribs MB-2 (285K); Pan Seared Duck Breast (179K); Cryptonite cocktail (149K)
why_its_here: A restaurant and cocktail bar on Jl. Munduk Catu seating up to 132 across five indoor and outdoor areas, rooftop included. The kitchen does steaks, seafood and pasta, with a vegan list; the cocktail and mocktail list is long. Happy hour (4-7pm daily): buy two cocktails, get one free.
best_for: A date night, a group dinner or a birthday, with live acoustic sessions on Saturdays
not_for: A quiet solo laptop session or a fast grab-and-go lunch: the restaurant seats up to 132 across five areas
full_address: Canggu / Munduk Catu

name: Beach House by Tonic
what_to_order: Super Relaxing Foot Massage (60 min) — 250K IDR.
why_its_here: Beach House by Tonic is a day spa in Canggu with a 60-item treatment list that takes in traditional, Balinese and deep tissue massage. The Super Relaxing Foot Massage is 250K IDR for an hour, booked on the spa's own site.
best_for: A three-hour session, or a foot massage after a day on your feet
full_address: Jl. Padang Linjong No.86, Canggu, Bali, Indonesia

name: Beachtown Grocer
address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: Daily 99K special (rotates by day); grab-and-go breakfast pastries; deli sandwiches
why_its_here: Beachtown Grocer is a New York deli-style café and grocery counter inside Secana Beachtown in Berawa, open 6am to 11pm. The daily special rotates and costs 99K. Sit indoors or alfresco, or take breakfast and groceries to go.
best_for: A deli breakfast or the 99K daily special, with groceries to grab on the way out
not_for: A quiet solo breakfast — the alfresco section allows smoking and gets social.
full_address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Beautyfulspa
opening_hours: Open 7 days a week, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM
what_to_order: Bali Paradise Massage (90 min) — 270K IDR.
why_its_here: Beautyfulspa in Canggu is a day spa whose six treatments include traditional massage and aromatherapy. A 90-minute massage from the list costs 270K IDR. Book on the spa's own site.
best_for: A 90-minute massage or aromatherapy
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.18X Blok A, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali

name: Bella
why_its_here: Bella's kitchen in Canggu is contemporary Mediterranean and Middle Eastern. 'Geisha' and 'Kopi Martini' are both on the menu, and you can book online.
best_for: A Mediterranean or Middle Eastern meal in Canggu
full_address: Berawa

name: Billy Ho Japanese Restaurant
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: Charcoal-grilled yakitori; fresh sushi and sashimi; early-bird cocktails Mon-Thu 5-6:30pm
why_its_here: Billy Ho pairs a modern Japanese kitchen with a cocktail bar on Batu Bolong, open through a long run from lunch to dinner. Yakitori, sushi and shareable plates make up the menu, the cocktails get hand-carved ice, and DJs play at weekends.
best_for: Japanese small plates and cocktails over a long lunch that rolls into dinner
not_for: A quiet dinner — weekend DJs push the energy up late.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Blue Karma Village
why_its_here: Blue Karma Village is a wellness spa in Canggu where the nine-item list mixes Balinese massage with yoga and Pilates. Booking is on its own site.
best_for: Yoga or Pilates while you're in Canggu
full_address: Umalas, Bali, Indonesia

name: Body Factory Bali
address: Nelayan / Canggu
price_anchor: 4-week membership: Bronze 1,996,000 IDR++, Silver 2,490,000 IDR++, Gold 3,594,000 IDR++ (excludes 10% tax and 5% service). Day-pass prices not published in readable text.
what_to_order: HYROX All Levels; Factory Fit; Rumble Boxing - Fundamental
why_its_here: At Jl. Nelayan No.27, Body Factory's large gym opens 6am-10pm daily. More than 50 classes cover HYROX, strength, boxing, mat pilates, mobility and yoga. Recovery runs from hot tub and sauna to ice bath and cold plunge, with a pool too.
best_for: A gym or HYROX session on a 1, 3, 7 or 14-day pass or a four-week membership
not_for: A gym-only pass if you want the ice bath and sauna, because recovery is a separate tier
full_address: Nelayan / Canggu

name: Body Factory Bali Recovery
address: Nelayan / Canggu
why_its_here: The recovery wing of Body Factory in Nelayan, open 6am to 10pm. Ice baths, sauna and bodywork here are aimed at recovery after training.
best_for: After training, when you want cold plunge and sauna rather than a traditional spa
full_address: Nelayan / Canggu

name: Boheme Restaurant at Shore Amora Canggu
address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.159, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali
why_its_here: The all-day restaurant and bar at Shore Amora Canggu on Jl. Pantai Pererenan, open 7am-10pm daily to hotel and day guests. The Western menu uses local, seasonal produce, with vegan, gluten-free and lactose-free options. Next to it are an infinity pool with daybeds and an air-conditioned coworking space open until 10pm.
best_for: A slow brunch, or a laptop-and-coffee day by the pool
not_for: A beachfront table or a night out: it closes at 10pm and looks over rice fields
full_address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.159, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali

name: Bokashi Bali (Pererenan)
address: Jalan Pantai Pererenan No.159, Pererenan, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jalan Pantai Pererenan No.159 in Canggu.
best_for: Travellers who want to check availability and reserve a table through Chope.
full_address: Jalan Pantai Pererenan No.159, Pererenan, Bali 80361

name: Bokashi Bali at Berawa
address: Jl. Subak Sari No.2, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
price_anchor: Brunch plates 45-145K · Soup and noodles 80-125K · Donburi 150-275K · Espresso coffee 35-40K · Single-origin teas 35-60K · +10% tax +7% service
what_to_order: Chilled Soba Noodles (90K); Okonomiyaki (110K); Matcha Latte (45K)
why_its_here: A cafe and teahouse above the Bokashi organic grocery store on Jl. Subak Sari in Berawa, with about 30 seats. The food is Japanese-leaning brunch, bento, soba and donburi, with single-origin Indonesian teas and matcha to drink. The group's Pererenan branch is closed until further notice.
best_for: A calm daytime meal of health-conscious Japanese plates, with matcha or tea
not_for: Dinner, since it closes in the early evening, or a group that needs space: the upstairs room is small, about 30 seats
full_address: Jl. Subak Sari No.2, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Bonito Restaurant
address: Jl. Bumbak Dauh No.88, Kerobokan, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
price_anchor: $$$ · Taste of Bonito tasting menu 450K++/person (min 2 people)
what_to_order: Tagliolini al Tonno; Bottoni Cacio e Pepe; Taste of Bonito tasting menu (450K++/person, min 2)
why_its_here: Bonito is a seafood and Mediterranean kitchen on the roof of the Kleo Hotel in Kerobokan Kelod, run by the team behind MAURI Seminyak. Pasta is handmade and seafood comes in fresh daily. Thursday is an all-you-can-eat oyster-and-pasta night.
best_for: A rooftop dinner of Mediterranean seafood and pasta, shared or as a tasting menu
full_address: Jl. Bumbak Dauh No.88, Rooftop, Kleo Hotel Seminyak, Kerobokan Kelod, Bali 80361

name: Bottega Italiana
address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
why_its_here: Gourmet Italian home-cooking from the Zibiru group (running since 2015), making its own fresh pasta, bread, cheese and desserts.
best_for: Families and groups sharing pasta
not_for: Breakfast — the kitchen opens at 11am.
full_address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa

name: Brother Gym
price_anchor: Day pass 75K · 1 week 400K · 1 month 600K · 3 months 1,700K · 1 year 6,500K · One-off first-visit admin fee 30K · PT 250K per 60-min session · Towel 10K
what_to_order: Personal training, 60-minute session (250K); 12-session PT pack with 1 free (3,000K); Kopi Gula Aren (25K)
why_its_here: Weights and machines fill Brother Gym at Jl. Raya Babakan No.14, open 6.30am-10pm daily. Day passes are sold, and so are weekly, monthly and annual memberships. Its counter adds protein shakes and scoops of supplements to the juice and coffee.
best_for: A low-cost weights session on a day pass, with personal training by the session or in packs
not_for: Paying for the day pass and nothing else: a first visit adds a one-off 30K admin fee, and the locker key needs a 50K deposit

name: Brunch Club Pererenan
address: Pererenan / Pantai Pererenan
what_to_order: Crème Brûlée Porncakes (90K); Babi Benny pork belly (145K); Pistachio Dubai Chocolate French Toast (165K)
why_its_here: Brunch Club Bali's Pererenan branch on Jl. Pantai Pererenan does brunch, lunch and cocktails all day. The group also has a Legian site. The house dish is Porncakes, a stacked pancake sold as a two- or three-stack in 14 flavours.
best_for: Friends or family over an all-day brunch of big sweet and savoury plates, with cocktails
not_for: Dinner: brunch and lunch are the only services listed
full_address: Pererenan / Pantai Pererenan

name: Cafe Coach
address: Jl. Nelayan No.8, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: Breakthrough Benny (brunch dish, 95K); Poke Bowl (95K); Long Black coffee (35-40K)
why_its_here: On Jl. Nelayan in Canggu, Cafe Coach is an all-day café that doubles as a wellness-coaching space and hosts workshops. The large menu runs from breakfast to dinner (benedicts, poke bowls, burgers), with coffee and cocktails.
best_for: Breakfast, or dinner that runs into cocktails
not_for: A quiet solo visit — the space also hosts coaching sessions and group events.
full_address: Jl. Nelayan No.8, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Café del Mar Bali
why_its_here: Café del Mar's Bali site, a beachfront club on Jl. Subak Sari in Tibubeneng, has an infinity pool, DJ sets and events. The kitchen calls itself premium casual dining from the Mediterranean Basin. Its desserts and cocktails are house creations. Open daily, 11:00 to 20:00.
best_for: Sunset drinks or a pool day, Ibiza-style, with a group after the beach
not_for: A late night out, because it closes at 8pm daily

name: CAFE VIDA Healthy Organic Restaurant Canggu
address: Canggu / Batu Bolong
why_its_here: An organic restaurant on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong 38A serving breakfast, lunch and dinner daily from 7am to 10:30pm, with vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options.
best_for: Organic breakfast, lunch or dinner with vegan and gluten-free options, from 7am
full_address: Canggu / Batu Bolong

name: Caffè Torino by Venticinque Group at Grand Srikandi Mansion
address: Jl. Cepaka Utama No.32, Dalung, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
price_anchor: Chope average 100-250K per person · Cake of the day with black coffee 40K nett
what_to_order: Tagliere di Affettati Misti; Amatriciana; Cake of the day with black coffee (40K nett)
why_its_here: An Italian cafe and restaurant from the Venticinque Group, inside Grand Srikandi Mansion on Jl. Cepaka Utama in Dalung, inland from the Canggu coast. Its Chope listing describes rice-field views and an all-day menu, from breakfast panini to cured-meat boards and pasta.
best_for: Italian coffee, cake and pasta over rice-field views at Grand Srikandi Mansion
full_address: Jl. Cepaka Utama No.32, Dalung, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Canggu Club Tennis Centre
why_its_here: The tennis centre of FINNS Recreation Club, formerly the Canggu Club, on Jl. Pantai Berawa. It has three indoor floodlit courts on a Flexipave surface, plus a pro shop, cafe and bar. Coaches and hitting partners are on hand, ball boys too.
best_for: Tennis out of the sun on a floodlit court, on a day pass or a membership open to the public

name: Canggu Scooter Bali
what_to_order: Honda Vario 110 — 60K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Vehicle rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers scooters and cars. Honda Vario 110 starts at 60K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.

name: Canggu Scooter Rental
what_to_order: Honda Vario 110cc — 70K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Scooter rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers scooters. Honda Vario 110cc starts at 70K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.
full_address: Jln.Raya Pantai Pererenan, GG Seruni No 1

name: Canggu Yoga Centre
address: Canggu
price_text: 1 class 160k IDR 160k
what_to_order: Beginner Ashtanga; hot yoga; HIIT inferno hot pilates
why_its_here: From early morning, Canggu Yoga Centre teaches Ashtanga, hot yoga and hot-pilates-style HIIT at its Pererenan studio. Showers and a cafe are on site, as is gear. The published timetable shifts, so check the day's classes before you go.
best_for: An accessible morning practice in Pererenan: Ashtanga, hot yoga or hot pilates
not_for: A fixed weekly routine: the published timetable shifts
full_address: Jalan Dalem Penataran No.8, Banjar Pengembungan, Desa Pererenan, Canggu, Bali

name: Cantina Classe — Canggu
address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.8C, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Italian restaurant on Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong, part of the Wonderspace group. Handmade pizza and fresh pasta. Fettuccine truffle carbonara and a four-cheese pizza are on the menu.
best_for: Pizza and pasta after a day at Batu Bolong

name: Casa Tua
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.10, Canggu
what_to_order: Bebek Betutu; Beef Rendang; Nasi Campur
why_its_here: Casa Tua, an Indonesian restaurant on Batu Bolong, has cooked Balinese family recipes since 2014. The plant-filled room splits between open-air tables and cosy indoor nooks, and resident rabbits roam free. It used to trade as Dandelion; the team and menu have not changed.
best_for: Balinese home cooking over a romantic meal among plants, with resident rabbits
not_for: Anyone who'd rather not share the floor with animals: free-running rabbits roam the dining area
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.10, Canggu

name: Chow Chow Bali
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong Gg. Nyepi No.22, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: Poke bowl (90K); slow-cooked pork ribs; sushi rolls
why_its_here: Chow Chow Bali is a contemporary Asian-fusion restaurant in Batu Bolong, open daily from late morning to midnight. The menu runs to sushi rolls, bao buns, slow-cooked pork ribs and poke bowls. Cocktails and a kids menu round it out.
best_for: From lunch to late night: Asian-fusion sushi, bao and poke bowls in Batu Bolong
not_for: A silent dinner — cocktails and a lively alley-side scene carry into the night.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong Gg. Nyepi No.22, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Cocomo at Canggu
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.99, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
what_to_order: Chili Garlic Prawns; Grilled Octopus; Pulled Pork and Prawn Herb Salad
why_its_here: An island bistro on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, a short way back from the shoreline, serving seafood and grilled dishes. Its Chope listing says it recently turned into a seafood-led coastal bistro. It is open 11:00-23:00 daily, with a lunch sitting until 5pm and dinner from 5pm.
best_for: Seafood or grill plates for lunch or dinner, a short way back from Batu Bolong beach
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.99, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Cocoon Medical Spa
opening_hours: Monday to Saturday: 10 AM – 6 PM; Sunday: Closed
why_its_here: An anti-aging facial, a detox treatment and spa packages are on the ten-item list at Cocoon Medical Spa, a wellness spa in Canggu. Book by WhatsApp.
best_for: An anti-aging facial or a detox treatment
full_address: Jl. Sunset Road, Legian, Bali, Indonesia

name: COMO Beach Club Canggu
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
price_anchor: Mains 150-610K · Small plates 60-190K · Sunday brunch 680K pp · +21% tax and service
what_to_order: COMO Burger (180K); Crispy Fish Tacos (165K); Canggu Caprese (145K)
why_its_here: The beach club and restaurant at COMO Uma Canggu, on the sand at Batu Mejan. It runs from breakfast to a 10pm dinner close with live music and DJ sets. Separate menus cover the main kitchen, a seafood BBQ and the COMO Shambhala Kitchen.
best_for: A polished sunset dinner or special occasion by the ocean, or a leisurely family-style Sunday brunch at 680K per person
not_for: Walking in unbooked, because guests not staying at COMO Uma Canggu need a reservation
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: COMO Shambhala Uma Canggu
why_its_here: At COMO Shambhala Uma Canggu, the wellness spa has 14 treatments, including traditional massage, a Javanese lulur and a body wrap. Bookings are made on its website.
best_for: A Javanese lulur, with body wraps on the list too
full_address: Jalan Pantai Batu Mejan, Echo Beach, Canggu, Bali 80361, Indonesia

name: COMO Uma Canggu Wellness / Spa
address: Echo Beach / Canggu
price_anchor: Massages IDR 450,000 (30 min) to 1,300,000 (90 min) · Facials 550,000-1,850,000 · Packages from 1,450,000 · +10% service +11% tax
what_to_order: COMO Shambhala Massage (75 min, IDR 1,000,000); Javanese Royal Lulur Bath (120 min, IDR 1,600,000); Hydradermie Lift facial (60 min, IDR 1,750,000)
why_its_here: Near Echo Beach, COMO Uma Canggu keeps its spa and wellness floor, the COMO Shambhala Retreat, open 10am to 7pm. Massages and body therapies share the menu with Sundari and Guinot facials and nail care. Yoga, Pilates, meditation and breathwork are booked as private sessions.
best_for: A 75-90 minute massage or a facial at a resort spa, or a private yoga or Pilates session
not_for: A treatment before 10am or after 7pm: it runs by appointment within those hours
full_address: Echo Beach / Canggu

name: Copenhagen CAFE Berawa
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa
why_its_here: A Nordic-inspired cafe and bakery in Berawa, built around a build-your-own feast: small dishes ticked off a menu card and served on a board. Smørrebrød, lunch bowls and house-baked pastries fill out the menu. Feasts run 6am-6pm, and lunch starts at 12pm.
best_for: Build-your-own Nordic breakfast boards from 6am, or daytime brunch and coffee
not_for: Laptop work or dinner: the cafe is laptop-free and food stops at 6pm
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa

name: Crate Cafe
address: Batu Bolong
why_its_here: An industrial-style all-day breakfast place on Jl. Batu Bolong. The smoothie bowls are big, and the menu rotates, chalked on the wall behind the counter.
best_for: An affordable all-day brunch on Batu Bolong, straight after a surf
not_for: A quiet sit-down or laptop work, because the room is loud, crowded and high-turnover, busiest after a surf
full_address: Pererenan

name: CutiePai Nails
address: Badung / Pererenan
what_to_order: BIAB / gel manicure; custom nail art
why_its_here: CutiePai Nails is a home-based nail salon in Pererenan, minutes from central Canggu, open daily 9am-7pm by appointment. It specialises in BIAB, gel nails, extensions, manicures, pedicures and custom hand-painted nail art, and sanitises tools between clients. Home visits are an option too.
best_for: A booked BIAB, gel or nail-art session in a small, private Pererenan setting
not_for: A walk-in visit — it's appointment-based, home-studio seating only.
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: CV. Rental Motor Canggu
what_to_order: Honda Vario 150/160 — 130K IDR Harian.
why_its_here: Scooter rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers scooters. Honda Vario 150/160 starts at 130K IDR Harian. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.

name: Desa Seni Yoga
address: Berawa boundary / verify pin
why_its_here: Daily classes in an open-air wooden shala make up the yoga programme of Desa Seni, a village-style resort near Berawa.
best_for: A drop-in class in a garden setting, then a meal at the resort's organic café
full_address: Berawa boundary / verify pin

name: Deus Ex Machina
address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
why_its_here: On Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Deus's flagship "Temple of Enthusiasm" pairs a Pan-Asian cafe and bar with a motorcycle workshop. A retail store, a gallery and a live-music venue share the site, open from morning coffee until late.
best_for: Coffee and brunch by day, or a night of live music with a crowd
not_for: A quiet or intimate dinner — Tuesdays and Sundays run live-music nights.
full_address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa

name: Dodo Pizza
address: Jl. Anggrek, Tibubeneng, Canggu, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
what_to_order: pizza
why_its_here: Pizzeria on Jl. Anggrek, part of the Dodo chain. Dine-in and delivery. The delivery promise is 30 minutes, with a free-pizza code if it runs late.
best_for: A pizza delivered to the villa
not_for: An independent kitchen - this is an international chain

name: Downtown Kedungu - Restaurant & Bar
address: Jl. Pantai Kedungu, Kedungu, Belalang, Kec. Kediri, Kabupaten Tabanan, Bali 82121
what_to_order: Tuesday 30K tacos, all day; Sunday roast (book ahead)
why_its_here: Downtown Kedungu, a Latin American restaurant and bar at Kedungu beach in Tabanan, sits about twenty minutes up the coast from Canggu. Every day of the week brings a different themed special.
best_for: A trip up the coast for Latin American plates and the day's themed special
not_for: A spontaneous Sunday. The roast sells out, and the site asks you to book ahead
full_address: Jl. Pantai Kedungu, Kedungu, Belalang, Kec. Kediri, Kabupaten Tabanan, Bali 82121

name: E.A.R.T.H Restaurant & Lounge
address: Ulaman Road, Buwit, Kec. Kediri, Kabupaten Tabanan, Bali 82121
price_anchor: À la carte 65-200K · Chef's selection from 350K/person · plus 21% tax and service
what_to_order: Sate Lilit (150K); Sate Ayam (150K); Chicken Pakora (125K)
why_its_here: E.A.R.T.H is the bamboo-built restaurant and lounge of the Ulaman Eco Luxury Resort in Buwit, Tabanan. Chef Alvin cooks Balinese and Nusantara food, and Italian, Thai and international dishes too. Set options range from a chef's selection to a waterfall-deck dinner.
best_for: Balinese or Nusantara meals at the Ulaman eco resort, among jungle, river and waterfalls
not_for: Families with young children — the resort advises against under-12s.
full_address: Ulaman Road, Buwit, Kec. Kediri, Kabupaten Tabanan, Bali 82121

name: Echo Bali Car Rental
what_to_order: Honda Scoopy — 100K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Vehicle rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers cars and scooters. Honda Scoopy starts at 100K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan No.80361, Canggu,Badung, Bali

name: Ecosfera Hotel
why_its_here: Ecosfera Hotel's wellness spa in Canggu keeps six treatments on its list, from traditional massage to a manicure and a pedicure.
best_for: A traditional massage, or a manicure and pedicure, at the hotel spa in Canggu
full_address: Jl Batu Mejan, Echobeach – Canggu, Kuta, Bali, Indonesia

name: Ecosfera Yoga Canggu
address: Batu Mejan / Echo Beach
why_its_here: The yoga programme at Ecosfera near Echo Beach, running classes in an eco-styled shala by the water.
best_for: A yoga class by the water, near Batu Mejan and Echo Beach
full_address: Batu Mejan / Echo Beach

name: ELE Restaurant, Bar and Terrace
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, 12, Canggu 80361
why_its_here: ELE keeps an all-day restaurant, bar and terrace on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong in Canggu, serving breakfast through late dinner. It has no website, only a link page, so we have confirmed the format and the address but not the menu.
best_for: Any meal from breakfast to a late dinner on Batu Bolong
not_for: Booking ahead online — reservations go through WhatsApp only.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, 12, Canggu 80361

name: ESKQ Bar Steak House
address: Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80351
price_anchor: Steaks 280-490K (Tomahawk 1,800K, pre-order) · Starters 35-235K · Pasta and risotto 90-175K · No tax or service note published
what_to_order: Picanha Steak Wagyu Tokusen (450K); Rib Eye Steak USA (490K); Bone Marrow (105K)
why_its_here: A steakhouse and wine bar on Jl. Raya Babakan with a list of 50+ wines. Wood-fired cuts go from Australian grain-fed skirt and picanha to a pre-order Tomahawk, and there is Italian pasta and risotto. The kitchen runs 6pm to 2am, Tuesday to Sunday, with live jazz on Fridays.
best_for: A late steak-and-wine dinner, or live jazz on a Friday
not_for: Lunch or a Monday night: it opens for dinner only, from 6pm, and is closed Mondays
full_address: Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80351

name: Espace Spa Bali
what_to_order: Crystal aromatheraphy foot reflexology (60 min) — 299K IDR.
why_its_here: Espace Spa Bali is a massage studio in Canggu with 22 treatments, including deep tissue, pregnancy massage and a four-hands massage. An hour of crystal aromatherapy foot reflexology costs 299K IDR, booked on the studio's own site.
best_for: An hour of crystal aromatherapy reflexology for walking-sore feet
full_address: Canggu

name: Espace Spa Canggu
address: Canggu
price_anchor: Massages 299-715K · Facials 275-356K · Scrubs and wraps 546-566K · Packages 475-767K
what_to_order: Four hands massage 60 min (554K); Tension Relief deep tissue 60 min (323K); Royal Javanese Mandi Lulur 120 min (546K)
why_its_here: Espace Spa, a day spa on Jl. Pura Batu Mejan near Batu Bolong, publishes its price list. It covers aromatherapy massage, body scrubs, wraps, facials, cream bath, manicures, pedicures and sugaring hair removal. It also runs private massage classes and sells massage tables and chairs.
best_for: A fixed-price massage, scrub, facial or nail treatment booked online in Batu Bolong
full_address: Canggu

name: Estetica Belle
address: Badung / Pererenan
price_anchor: Dermalogica facials 660-2,230K · Doctor Babor facials 1,130K · Mesopeel peels 580K · Lash lift 400K · Gel pedicure 410K · Skin-treatment prices exclude 6.5% service charge
what_to_order: Glass Skin Glow facial 120 min (2,230K); Mesopeel MD Retiflash 30 min (580K); Keratin Lash Lift Tint (400K)
why_its_here: Estetica Belle works from a beauty studio at Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.69. It does lashes, brows, nails, waxing, permanent make-up, skin needling and laser tattoo removal. Clinical facials use Dermalogica and Doctor Babor products, plus Mesoestetic. The skin-treatment price list is on its own site.
best_for: Lashes, brows, nails, waxing and clinical facials in one Pererenan studio
not_for: An evening or walk-in treatment: it closes at 6pm daily and works by appointment
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: F45 Training Canggu
address: Canggu
opening_hours:
Monday: 6:30am–12pm 3:30–5:30pm
Tuesday: 6:30am–12pm 3:30–5:30pm
Wednesday: 6:30am–12pm 3:30–5:30pm
Thursday: 6:30am–12pm 3:30–5:30pm
Friday: 6:30am–12pm 3:30–4:30pm
Saturday: 8–11:30am
Sunday: 8:30–10:30am
why_its_here: The Canggu studio of the global F45 franchise, at Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.83, running 45-minute classes. Its ClassPass schedule puts cardio on Mondays and Wednesdays and resistance on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Sundays. Fridays and Saturdays are hybrid sessions.
best_for: A coached 45-minute class mixing HIIT, circuit and functional training
not_for: A spur-of-the-moment visit, because sessions run to a fixed timetable and must be booked in advance
full_address: Canggu

name: Face Therapy Spa Pererenan
address: Badung / Pererenan
price_anchor: Face treatments 690K (60 min) to 1,495K (120 min) · Two-person session 1,380K
what_to_order: Face Therapy - Signature Massage 60 min (690K); Buccal massage - Deep Sculpt 75 min (920K); Gua Sha massage - Lymphatic Reset 75 min (805K)
why_its_here: Face Therapy, a face-massage spa on Jl. Tukad Pingai in Pererenan, opens 8am to 10pm daily. Treatments cover gua sha, buccal sculpting, lymphatic work and jetlag recovery. Its Fresha listing says woman-owned and kid- and pet-friendly, and names a second branch in Umalas.
best_for: Gua sha and buccal sculpting, or a jetlag-recovery face treatment after a long flight
not_for: A quick drop-in, since treatments are booked ahead and run 60-120 minutes
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: Fajar Bali Luxury Spa
what_to_order: Mom to Be Massage — 505K IDR.
why_its_here: With 34 treatments, Fajar Bali Luxury Spa is a day spa in Canggu covering spa packages, facials and traditional massage. The Mom to Be Massage costs 505K IDR, and booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: Couples, since a couple treatment is on the list
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No. 22 Banjar Canggu

name: FINNS Beach Club
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa near Finns
price_anchor: Free entry, no minimum spend · Party bed from 1.5M · Party super bed from 2.5M
why_its_here: On a 170m stretch of Berawa beachfront, FINNS Beach Club is a day club with three pools, including swim-up bars. There are many bars and kitchens, and a daily lineup of DJs and live vocalists. It is the high-energy, pool-party end of Canggu's beach clubs.
best_for: A lively, high-energy pool day and sunset party with a big group
not_for: Under-16s — entry is restricted to over-16s.
full_address: Jalan Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Bali

name: FINNS Recreation Club / FINNS Lifestyle Village
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa
why_its_here: FINNS Recreation Club is the large membership club at FINNS Lifestyle Village in Berawa. It has a full gym, an Olympic-sized pool, tennis and padel courts and a kids' club. Recovery means ice baths and an infrared sauna plus compression therapy; the spa is full-service Balinese.
best_for: Families and active travellers on a longer Canggu or Berawa stay, on a day pass or a membership
not_for: A quiet, intimate boutique spa. The club is big and has many facilities
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa

name: Fitness Plus Canggu
what_to_order: Les Mills BodyPump; Les Mills RPM; Positive Spin
why_its_here: Fitness Plus Canggu, part of the Indonesian Fitness Plus chain, runs a 24-hour gym at Jl. Tanah Barak No.19. Its branch site lists more than 100 machines. The eight group programmes are Les Mills BodyPump, RPM, BodyCombat and Ceremony; Positive Spin; Mat Pilates; yoga; and Zumba.
best_for: A workout at any hour, with a sauna, lockers, showers, towels and parking on site

name: Flex Gym Bali
price_anchor: Day pass 150K · 7 days 450K · 14 days 650K · 1 month 850K · 12 months 4,990K · Personal training from 450K
what_to_order: Day pass (150K); 7-day pass (450K)
why_its_here: Flex Gym has a single location: a gym on Gang Heliconia, off Jl. Raya Canggu. Strength equipment, from squat racks to machines, shares the floor with treadmills, rowers and air bikes. Passes run from a single day to twelve months. It has lockers and changing rooms, and parking.
best_for: Drop-in strength sessions on a 150K day pass, from 06:30 on weekdays
not_for: An evening workout at the weekend, because it closes at 18:00 on Saturday and Sunday

name: Focaccia Buddies
address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.107, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
what_to_order: matcha; sandwich
why_its_here: Focaccia sandwiches in Pererenan, run by two friends. Toppings include mortadella and stracciatella, and you can build your own. Coffee and matcha alongside.
best_for: A sandwich and coffee between surfs

name: Gather
why_its_here: Gather is a breakfast and brunch restaurant in Canggu, and you book a table by WhatsApp. The menu has The Classic Brekkie, The Avo Set and The Gather Plate.
best_for: Breakfast or brunch in Canggu: the Classic Brekkie or the Avo Set
full_address: Pererenan, Bali

name: Genius Bistro
address: Jl. Sempol, Pererenan, Canggu, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
what_to_order: Table Serving Duck; Braised Lamb Shank
why_its_here: Among rice fields north of central Canggu, Genius Bistro cooks French, Mediterranean and steakhouse food on Jl. Sempol. About 50 seats split between indoors and al fresco. The kitchen leans French: duck served at the table, braised lamb shank, duck a l'orange. Book through Chope.
best_for: A sit-down meal of French cooking or steak among rice fields north of central Canggu
full_address: Jl. Sempol, Pererenan, Canggu, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: GFS-Bike by Global Go
what_to_order: Honda Scoopy — 100K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Vehicle rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers scooters and motorbikes. Honda Scoopy starts at 100K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.
full_address: Jalan Batu Bolong, Canggu

name: Glo Bali
why_its_here: Facials, traditional massage and spa packages are part of the 34-treatment list at Glo Bali, a beauty salon in Canggu. Booking is on the salon's own site.
best_for: A facial at a beauty salon in Canggu

name: Glo Day Spa & Salon Canggu
address: Canggu
why_its_here: One of five Bali branches of Glo Salon & Beauty, which used to trade as Glo Day Spa & Salon. It sits at Jl. Subak Sari 90, opposite Popular supermarket. It covers hair, facials, nails, waxing, threading, lash and brow, spray tanning and makeup.
best_for: Hair, nails, waxing and facials in one Canggu salon, open 10am to 8pm
not_for: An early-morning or late-evening slot: it opens at 10am and closes at 8pm
full_address: Canggu

name: Goldust Beauty / Facials
address: Canggu
price_text: Express Lifting Facial: 350k++ IDR (45 mins)
why_its_here: The facial and beauty side of Goldust, a Canggu day spa. Its treatments are results-focused, the Express Lifting Facial among them.
best_for: A results-focused facial or skin treatment rather than a quick massage
full_address: Canggu

name: Goldust Spa
address: Canggu
price_text: Express Lifting Facial (45min) 350k++; Sports Massage 60min 650k++ / 90min 950k++; Lymphatic Drainage (60min) 650k++; Intuitive Body Work (90min) 850k++; Madero Body Sculpting (90min) 750k++ (IDR)
price_anchor: Massages 280-650K (60min), 380-950K (90min) · Facials 350K-1,750K · Luxury manicure 300K · Spray tan 400K · All exclude 5% service + 15% government tax
what_to_order: Sports massage (60min 650K); Madero Body Sculpting (90min 750K); Express Lifting Facial (45min 350K)
why_its_here: Goldust Spa is a day spa on Gg. Nyepi, off Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong. Under one roof are massage suites, a poolside lounge, a nail lounge and a couple's room. The list runs from 30-minute poolside massages to 24k Gold facials and two-and-a-half-hour couple's packages.
best_for: Therapeutic bodywork, from sports and lymphatic drainage to Madero body sculpting, rather than a basic massage
full_address: Canggu

name: Gravity Stretching Canggu
price_anchor: Group class 300K · 6-class loyalty card 1,500K · Private session 1,200K
what_to_order: Group class Gravity Stretching (300K); MONKEYS children's stretching class (300K); private Gravity Therapy session (1,200K)
why_its_here: A stretching studio built on suspended ropes: the exercises are done in relaxation rather than tension, so gravity takes the load off the muscles. The Bali operation has studios in Canggu and Ubud, with group classes, private Gravity Therapy sessions and a children's class.
best_for: Rope-suspension stretching for stiff backs and hips; drop-in group or private
not_for: An unbooked visit: classes go through the studio app or WhatsApp

name: Green Spot Cafe
address: Echo Beach Villa and Apartment, Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
price_anchor: Breakfast 35-70K · Lunch mains 60-115K · Menu prints figures in thousands of IDR, with no tax or service note
what_to_order: BBB Big Beef Burger (80K); Tuna Poke Bowl (75K); Grilled Salmon Fillet with risotto (100K)
why_its_here: Green Spot, the cafe of Ecosfera Hotel at Echo Beach, serves an all-day international menu of breakfasts, burgers, bowls and grills. Its menu page lists breakfast from 35K and lunch mains up to 115K, plus weekly deals like a Wednesday burger-and-drink and Sunday two-for-one smoothies.
best_for: A big, low-priced breakfast or burger at Echo Beach, with the kitchen open until 11pm
full_address: Echo Beach Villa and Apartment, Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Grillos Cafe & Eatery
address: Jl. Veteran No.99A, Buduk, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: A cafe and coffee shop on Jl. Veteran at Buduk, inland from Canggu in Mengwi, open 07:00-23:00 daily. Its own Grab listing describes the kitchen as Western cooking with Eastern flavours.
best_for: A coffee or a meal inland at Buduk, in a cafe open 7am to 11pm
not_for: Anyone on foot from the Canggu beach strip, because Buduk is out in Mengwi
full_address: Jl. Veteran No.99A, Buduk, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Guan Yin Yoga Canggu
address: Canggu
what_to_order: Vinyasa Flow drop-in (150K); Introduction to Ashtanga; private class (750K)
why_its_here: Guan Yin has its yoga shala on the upper floor of Hotel Tugu Bali, on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong at Canggu Beach. The published timetable runs Vinyasa, Yin, Hatha Flow, Ashtanga, Kundalini, Qigong, gentle Pilates and guided meditation. Non-guests can walk in.
best_for: A small drop-in class upstairs at Hotel Tugu, walk-ins welcome
not_for: Dropping in at any hour, because classes run only on the weekly timetable
full_address: Canggu

name: HairShop Canggu
address: Tegal Gundul Square, Jl. Pantai Berawa No.52 Unit 10, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Bali 80361
why_its_here: HairShop is the Canggu branch of a Bali hair-salon brand, in Tegal Gundul Square on Jl. Pantai Berawa. English-speaking stylists do cuts, colour and blow-outs in an air-conditioned space.
best_for: A haircut or colour on the road, booked easily by WhatsApp
full_address: Canggu

name: Hati Thai
what_to_order: Foot Serenity – Foot Reflexology (60 min) — 160K IDR.
why_its_here: Thai massage sits alongside traditional and Balinese at Hati Thai, a day spa in Canggu with 33 treatments. An hour of Foot Serenity reflexology costs 160K IDR, and bookings run through Fresha.
best_for: Reflexology for tired feet, or a session as long as two hours
full_address: Jl. Raya Semat, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonezja

name: Hip Hop Soul Restaurant
address: Jalan Raya Canggu, Canggu, Bali 80351
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jalan Raya Canggu.
best_for: Travellers who want to check availability and reserve a table through Chope.
full_address: Jalan Raya Canggu, Canggu, Bali 80351

name: Hippie Fish Pererenan Beach
address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pererenan Beach
why_its_here: A Mediterranean-inspired restaurant, rooftop and bar on Pererenan Beach, with a seafood-led kitchen. The second-floor dining room is air-conditioned and overlooks the beach, and the rooftop bar above it faces the sunset.
best_for: A beachfront sunset dinner, a date night with a view, or seafood shared with a group
not_for: Walk-ins or breakfast, since it opens at midday and says booking is essential
full_address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pererenan Beach

name: HOME by Chef Wayan
address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No. 92, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
price_anchor: Mains 95-180K · Sate 25-85K per stick · Five-course set 395K · Excl. 10% tax and 5% service
what_to_order: Ayam Serosop (160K); Babi Guling (85K); Bebek Se'i (180K)
why_its_here: Near the beach on Jl. Pantai Pererenan, Chef Wayan Kresna Yasa runs HOME, a modern Balinese restaurant. The kitchen reworks family and island recipes with contemporary technique. Vegan dishes are marked on every course, next to sate, seafood and traditional mains.
best_for: Tables that mix meat, seafood and vegan eaters over a considered Balinese dinner
not_for: A walk-in table. The restaurant asks you to book ahead

name: HOME Cafe MENGWI
address: Br. Tiying Tutul No.19, Pererenan, Mengwi, Badung Regency, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: A brunch cafe in Tiying Tutul, Pererenan. It describes its own cooking as healthy.
best_for: Brunch away from the Batu Bolong strip

name: Honey Kitchen
address: Badung / Pererenan
why_its_here: An all-day cafe and restaurant at Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.132, open 7am to 10pm daily. Its listings describe Mediterranean and vegetarian-friendly cooking with separate brunch and dinner menus, plus outdoor seating, wifi and parking.
best_for: A long Mediterranean brunch on the Pererenan beach road, or a 7am breakfast.
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: Honeycomb Bali
address: Jalan Raya Canggu, Pererenan, Bali 80351
why_its_here: Cafe on Jalan Raya Canggu.
best_for: Travellers who want to check availability and reserve a table through Chope.
full_address: Jalan Raya Canggu, Pererenan, Bali 80351

name: House of Orange Beauty Canggu
address: Canggu
why_its_here: A nail salon at Jl. Pantai Berawa No.5 in Canggu, open daily 10:00-18:00. Its own site states it works on natural nails only, with no extensions or electric files, and it takes WhatsApp bookings as well as walk-ins.
best_for: Natural-nail manicures and pedicures in Berawa, walk-ins welcome.
not_for: Extensions or electric-file work, because it does natural nails only
full_address: Canggu

name: Hubble
why_its_here: Hookah lounge in Canggu. An elegant restaurant, shisha lounge and cocktail bar concept with bold décor, perfect for lunch, dinner or drinks, offering relaxing dining and contemporary lounge seating. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: An evening of shisha and drinks, not live entertainment.

name: Hungry Bird Coffee Roaster
address: Jl. Segara Perancak No.86, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: A coffee roaster and daytime cafe on Jl. Segara Perancak in Tibubeneng, open 8am to 5pm daily. It roasts its own beans, sells single-origin bags through its own online store, and takes coffee-class enquiries.
best_for: Morning coffee from a working roastery, plus beans to take home.
not_for: Dinner: it closes at 5pm daily

name: Indigo
address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.7A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Indigo has served Japanese food in Berawa since 2017 under Kyoto-trained chef Morita Shigehiko. There is a sushi and sashimi selection, and yakimono cooked over charcoal. The room is small and deliberately plain, with shoji-style doors, timeworn teak and indigo denim cushions.
best_for: A quiet meal of sushi and charcoal-grilled yakimono in a small Berawa room
not_for: An afternoon meal — closed 15:00-18:00 between services, and all day Sunday.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.7A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Inklusiv Warung
address: Jl. Munduk Catu No.8A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
price_anchor: Drag-show nights 150K per person - Chope spend band 100-250K per person
what_to_order: Tunisian Shakshuka; Braised Rabbit in Cuban Curry Butter; Bali Guling Pork Belly
why_its_here: A warung at Jl. Munduk Catu No.8A whose own listings describe a mission to empower the Deaf and other minorities through employment. It serves Indonesian and European food from early morning until late and runs drag shows on Wednesday, Friday and Sunday nights.
best_for: Drag nights and late food at a Deaf-staffed, all-welcome Canggu warung.
not_for: A low-key evening on Wed, Fri or Sun, when drag shows run from 8pm (150K per person)
full_address: Jl. Munduk Catu No.8A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: ISLA by Earth Island
address: Canggu / Canggu shortcut / Subak Canggu
price_anchor: Mains 90-250K - Snacks 50-140K - Coffee 30-40K - plus 10% tax and 5% service
what_to_order: ISLA Surf Platter (90K); Grilled Octopus (130K); Island Ceviche (80K)
why_its_here: ISLA, the all-day cafe at Earth Island's surf shop, sits at Jl. Subak Canggu No.77 on the Canggu shortcut. The menu goes from breakfast and coffee through seafood snacks and grilled mains to cocktails. The site calls it a space for events, music, art and film.
best_for: Breakfast or seafood snacks after a surf, at the Earth Island surf shop
not_for: Dinner from Sunday to Thursday, because it closes at 7pm; only Friday and Saturday run to 9pm
full_address: Canggu / Canggu shortcut / Subak Canggu

name: Jade by Todd English
address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Jade by Todd English is a Mediterranean restaurant and bar in Berawa built around an open wood-fire grill, with a menu designed for sharing. Dinner only, Tuesday to Sunday, running late into a bar service at the end of the week.
best_for: Wood-fire Mediterranean sharing plates, dinner only, in a small Berawa room.
not_for: Lunch or brunch — service starts at 5pm and it's closed Mondays.
full_address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Jalapeno
address: Jl. Raya Semat Gg. Anggur No.1, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: The Canggu branch of Jalapeno, at Jl. Raya Semat Gg. Anggur No.1 in Tibubeneng. Its own site describes the brand as modern Tex-Mex serving since 2014, with two venues, in Sanur and in Canggu.
best_for: A Tex-Mex dinner and margaritas in Canggu that runs late into the evening.
full_address: Jl. Raya Semat Gg. Anggur No.1, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Jen Deli Restaurant and La Fortuna Bar at Sense Canggu Beach Hotel
address: Jl. Munduk Kedungu No.55s, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Munduk Kedungu No.55s in Canggu, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu; Pererenan.
full_address: Jl. Munduk Kedungu No.55s, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali

name: Jet Black Ginger Canggu
address: Canggu
why_its_here: A Canggu hair salon specialising in cut and colour for all hair types, with online appointment booking.
best_for: A cut or colour by stylists used to international hair
full_address: Canggu

name: Ji Restaurant Bali
address: Canggu / Batu Bolong Beach
what_to_order: sushi
why_its_here: Japanese-contemporary dining at Hotel Tugu, right on Batu Bolong beach. The room is a reconstructed antique temple, and the terrace looks straight at the ocean. Sushi, Asian-fusion plates and cocktails.
best_for: A sunset dinner with a view, a date, or a special occasion by the sea
full_address: Canggu / Batu Bolong Beach

name: Ju Bali
address: 80361, Jl. Bumbak Dauh No.8, Kerobokan, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Ju Bali is a casual Umalas restaurant with a jacuzzi club. International comfort food with a Balinese turn: pasta, burgers and wood-fired pizza. Vegetarian and vegan plates include tandoori cauliflower and mushroom tagliatelle. Its 200 seats come with a kids menu and parking for cars and scooters.
best_for: Families and groups who need space and parking
not_for: A quiet dinner for two, because it is a 200-seat family venue

name: Jungle Padel Canggu
address: Canggu shortcut / verify branch
why_its_here: Jungle Padel runs padel courts in Canggu, open early until late for court hire and social games.
best_for: Groups and couples after a fun, active session on court instead of a gym
full_address: Canggu shortcut / verify branch

name: Jungle Padel Canggu Shortcut
address: Canggu / Canggu shortcut
what_to_order: Padel court booking; coaching sessions
why_its_here: A padel club on the Canggu shortcut, with panoramic glass-walled courts among tropical greenery. Courts are booked by the hour on the Jungle Padel app. Racket hire, coaching, a pro shop, changing rooms and an on-site café are all there.
best_for: A game between beach sessions: book a court for four, or come for a lesson, with racket hire on site
not_for: Total downtime or a spa-style wellness stop: this is a sports club, and peak-time courts need booking
full_address: Canggu / Canggu shortcut

name: Kecambah Restaurant at Lalasa Villas
address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Pantai Berawa No.12 Canggu Kuta, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Lalasa Villas on Pantai Berawa has Kecambah as its street-front restaurant, a casual room open from breakfast until late. The cooking leans Indonesian, with Western dishes too. There is a Balinese rijsttafel evening, and afternoon tea is booked ahead.
best_for: Breakfast through to a late dinner at Lalasa Villas, or the Balinese rijsttafel evening
not_for: Same-day afternoon tea — the villa asks for a day's notice on that menu.
full_address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Pantai Berawa No.12 Canggu Kuta, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Kedai Tepi Kali and Bar at Tapa Tepi Kali Canggu
address: Echo Beach, Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu.
full_address: Echo Beach, Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: KHAO Canggu
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Mejan, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu.

why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Pantai Berawa No.14b in Canggu, open daily 11:00am-12:00am.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu; Berawa.
