name: Kopiten
address: Jl. Raya Tumbakbayuh - Pererenan, Tumbak Bayuh, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: A small casual coffee shop in the Tumbakbayuh-Pererenan part of Canggu, open 07:30-20:00, serving espresso drinks alongside a short toast-based menu.
best_for: Remote workers and long-stay visitors after a quiet, low-key coffee away from the busier Canggu cafes

name: Korra Spa
why_its_here: Korra Spa in Canggu is a day spa with 18 treatments, including Balinese massage, a facial and a body scrub. Booking is on the spa's own site.
best_for: A body scrub or a facial, with treatments running up to two hours
not_for: A low-cost massage: Korra Spa's prices start at 650K IDR
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.23, Tibubeneng

name: KOYA SPA
what_to_order: BALI BLISS MASSAGE (60 min) — 350K IDR.
why_its_here: KOYA SPA, a wellness spa in Canggu, lists 22 treatments, from traditional massage to deep tissue and a four-hands massage. The Bali Bliss Massage costs 350K IDR for an hour; book through Fresha.
best_for: Up to two hours on the massage table in Canggu
full_address: Tegalgundul square, Jl. Pantai Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: La Brisa Bali
address: Canggu / Echo Beach
price_anchor: Pizzas 150-215K · Large plates 170-285K · Cocktails 150K · plus 8% service, 10% tax
what_to_order: Tuna Crudo (95K); Ceviche Nikkei (140K); 14HR Slow Cooked Lamb Shoulder (285K)
why_its_here: La Brisa is a rustic beach club on Echo Beach, hand-built from wood salvaged from old Indonesian fishing boats. It has a saltwater pool, a raw and oyster bar and wood-fired Mediterranean food. Expect a driftwood look and long, open sunset views over the surf break.
best_for: Sunset drinks and a beach day with friends, or a shared meal by the water
not_for: A low-spend sunset on a daybed: after 4pm, daybeds and cabanas carry a 1M-3.5M++ minimum spend
full_address: Canggu / Echo Beach

name: Lola’s Cantina Mexicana — Canggu
address: Canggu Shortcut, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
what_to_order: taco; margarita
why_its_here: Lola’s Cantina Canggu is a Mexican restaurant on the Canggu Shortcut serving tacos and cocktails.
best_for: Casual tacos and cocktails with a group or as a couple
full_address: Canggu Shortcut, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

name: LOOP cafe
address: Jl. Dalem Lingsir No.12, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
why_its_here: Eggs, salmon, chicken, cottage cheese, Greek yoghurt, oats and sourdough make up the menu at LOOP, a high-protein breakfast cafe in Pererenan. Six protein shakes are made for after training. Specialty coffee and smoothie bowls share the menu with wraps and vegan options.
best_for: Breakfast before the gym or after a surf
not_for: Dinner, since the kitchen closes at 18:00

name: Lopodo Catering & Events
address: Jl. Raya Canggu No.7x, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: Balinese Rijsttafel, 7 courses (450K++/person, min 8); Regal Javanese Heritage, 3 courses (300K++/person)
why_its_here: Lopodo is a Halal-certified catering and event company on Jl. Raya Canggu, cooking Indonesian, Balinese, Javanese, Asian and Western menus for villas, weddings, corporate events and private-chef bookings, with its own event space in Canggu.
best_for: Villa catering, private chefs and set-menu events — ordered ahead, not walk-in.
not_for: Walking in — the site sells set menus with an 8-guest minimum.
full_address: Jl. Raya Canggu No.7x, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: LowCal, Cheatery and Bar
address: Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong, No.94, Canggu, Bali 80361
why_its_here: LowCal, on Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong, builds a low-calorie menu that also covers paleolithic and ketogenic eating. It trains and employs deaf team members across kitchen, bar and service roles. Dinner choices include chicken, pork, fish and vegetarian dishes, with low-carb sides.
best_for: A health-led meal with low-carb choices, served by an inclusive team
not_for: A traditional Balinese warung meal, because the menu is built around low-calorie, paleolithic and ketogenic food
full_address: Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong, No.94, Canggu, Bali 80361

name: Luigi’s Hot Pizza
address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
what_to_order: Queen Marg (120K); Al Capone (140K); Babi Bali (150K)
why_its_here: A big, loud Neapolitan pizza place on Jl. Batu Mejan, built out of shipping containers. The wood-fired oven was imported from Napoli, and there are party nights every week.
best_for: Pizza and drinks any day from 4pm, or one of the weekly party nights
not_for: Breakfast or lunch — it opens at 4pm daily.
full_address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa

name: Lulu Bistrot
address: Canggu / Batu Bolong
why_its_here: On Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, Lulu Bistrot cooks classic French bistro dishes with local, seasonal ingredients. The room and bar take their cue from the grand cafes. It opens in the evenings, with an early happy hour.
best_for: Couples and small groups after an unhurried French dinner and drinks
not_for: A quick warung stop or a budget meal: Lulu serves unhurried French bistro dinners
full_address: Canggu / Batu Bolong

name: Luma
address: Canggu / Batu Bolong
what_to_order: Rustic Spanish- and Italian-style small plates for sharing.
why_its_here: An intimate, 30-seat open-air spot on Batu Bolong, Luma cooks rustic Mediterranean small plates. The chefs are Cameron Emirali, of 10 Greek Street in London, and Kieran Morland, of Merah Putih and Sangsaka. Beer and cocktails are on tap; vinyl DJs play at weekends.
best_for: Spanish- and Italian-style grazing over golden-hour drinks, on a date or as a lively pre-dinner stop that becomes the evening
full_address: Canggu / Batu Bolong

name: Luna & Sol Pilates - Yoga
why_its_here: Luna & Sol teaches pilates on Jl. Raya Semat, with classes on the reformer, chair and springboard as well as the mat, plus yoga. Levels mix beginner and intermediate, and some classes also run on Zoom.
best_for: Equipment pilates rather than mat work

name: Lyma Beach
address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pantai Lima / Seseh-Cemagi route
why_its_here: Lyma Beach is a beachfront bar and restaurant on Pantai Lima, where the river meets the ocean. Expect sunset views, cocktails and live entertainment through the week.
best_for: Sunset drinks with a group, or a beachfront meal to live music
not_for: A quiet work session or an intimate fine-dining evening, because there's live entertainment through the week
full_address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pantai Lima / Seseh-Cemagi route

name: Maja
why_its_here: Maja is a wellness spa in Canggu with five treatments, including traditional massage and a hydrating facial. Book on its own site.
best_for: Two hours set aside for a treatment
not_for: Anyone after a budget massage — prices start at 1080K IDR

name: Manhattan Cocktail Hookah Kitchen
address: Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong No.58, Canggu, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Manhattan puts shisha service and a kitchen alongside a cocktail bar on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong. It publishes no website beyond a link page, and its menu is not readable online. We can confirm the format, the address and WhatsApp booking.
best_for: Cocktails and shisha with a kitchen attached, on Batu Bolong
not_for: A smoke-free room — hookah is part of the format, by the venue's own name.
full_address: Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong No.58, Canggu, Bali 80361

name: Manori Spa
what_to_order: Therapeutic massage - Traditional Oriental – Full Body (60 min) — 200K IDR.
why_its_here: Pregnancy massage and reflexology sit next to traditional massage at Manori Spa, a wellness spa in Canggu with 21 treatments. An hour of therapeutic massage, traditional oriental and full body, costs 200K IDR.
best_for: Reflexology after walking all day, or a treatment of up to two hours

name: Mason
address: Batu Bolong
why_its_here: Trading as MASONRY., Mason runs a moody, minimalist grill on Batu Bolong. The cooking is wood-fired and leans Mediterranean, the charcuterie is made in-house, and there is a wine and cocktail list.
best_for: A sit-down meal of wood-fired grill, charcuterie and wine, from midday to late
not_for: Lunch in the Chop House room, which runs dinner only, Tuesday to Saturday
full_address: Batu Bolong

name: Mavammy
address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.8, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Mavammy's dessert counter is built on Belgian chocolate, and breakfast runs all day at this café and patisserie on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong. The cakes include carrot cake with mango and passion fruit, and a Lotus cheesecake. The wifi is strong and there's air conditioning.
best_for: Cake and a laptop in the afternoon

name: Mello Spa Canggu
what_to_order: Mello Signature Massage (60 min) — 650K IDR.
why_its_here: Mello Spa Canggu is a wellness spa with 43 treatments, from facials and spa packages to traditional massage. An hour of the Mello Signature Massage is 650K IDR. Bookings go through Zenoti.
best_for: Up to 245 minutes of treatments, booked through Zenoti
full_address: Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.21b, Canggu

name: MESA BALI
what_to_order: Cocktail — 95K IDR.
why_its_here: Nightclub in Canggu. The venue describes itself as the heart of Canggu nightlife and one of the most iconic Bali nightclubs with international DJs and themed weekly events. Cocktail is 95K IDR. Happy hour: SPECIAL 95K COCKTAIL EVERYDAY!. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A late night out dancing, not a quiet dinner.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: MiA - Asian Modern-Inspired Restaurant & Bar
address: Jl. Raya Semat, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
opening_hours: Monday: 12.00pm-12.00am; Tuesday: 12.00pm-12.00am; Wednesday: 12.00pm-12.00am; Thursday: 12.00pm-12.00am; Friday: 6.00pm-1.00am; Saturday: 6.00pm-1.00am; Sunday: 12.00pm-12.00am
what_to_order: Wagyu Gyoza (245K); Crispy Soft Shell Crab (185K); Torched Salmon (195K)
why_its_here: Off Jl. Raya Semat, MiA is a modern Asian restaurant and bar built around sharing. Sushi rolls, raw plates, curries, wok and grill dishes make up the menu, and it runs into the early hours at weekends.
best_for: Dinner into the late hours over modern Asian sharing plates and sushi
not_for: A quiet dinner — it runs to midnight, and to 1am at weekends.
full_address: Jl. Raya Semat, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: MIEL Specialty Coffee Canggu
address: Canggu / Batu Bolong
what_to_order: Filter/brew-bar coffee (V60 or pour-over) and their signature single-origin filters; Big Brekkie; French toast with vanilla poached pears
why_its_here: MIEL is a specialty-coffee cafe on Batu Bolong with a brew bar for V60, pour-over and cold brew. The space is bright and plant-filled, with high ceilings. Spacious tables and fast wifi in a quiet room make it a work spot too.
best_for: Remote workers after filter coffee and a calm table for a few hours, or an easy morning brunch
not_for: An evening or late-night hangout; it is at its best in the daytime
full_address: Canggu / Batu Bolong

name: Milano
address: Jl. Pantai Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Pantai Berawa in Canggu, open daily 7:00am-1:00am.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu; Berawa.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Milk & Madu Beach Road
address: Canggu / Batu Bolong
what_to_order: Ricotta hotcakes; smashed avocado; lava-stone pizzas
why_its_here: An all-day cafe on Batu Bolong beach road, part of the Milk & Madu group. The room is spacious and shaded by palms, with a kids' play area, and the kitchen does brunch classics and lava-stone pizzas.
best_for: Families with young children and groups, from brunch to an early dinner or the daily sunset session
not_for: Couples after a quiet, intimate dinner
full_address: Canggu / Batu Bolong

name: Milk & Madu Berawa
address: Berawa / Tegal Gundul
what_to_order: Ricotta hotcakes; lava-stone pizzas.
why_its_here: The Berawa flagship of Milk & Madu, an all-day Canggu cafe brand. It does hearty brunch, lava-stone pizzas and family-friendly dinners.
best_for: Families and groups, from a big post-surf brunch to an easy all-day meal for fussy and hungry tables alike
not_for: A quiet, intimate dinner for a couple, because the dinners here are family-friendly
full_address: Berawa / Tegal Gundul

name: Milu by Nook
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa
what_to_order: Milu Benedict; Pan Seared Salmon Fillet
why_its_here: Milu by Nook, a restaurant on Jl. Pantai Berawa, has a garden looking over a small rice paddy. It serves Balinese-Western dishes and coffee from morning until night.
best_for: A calm garden brunch or dinner over a Berawa rice paddy
not_for: A budget breakfast — mains run 100-250K.
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa

name: Mission Flow Studio
address: Badung / Pererenan
what_to_order: Vinyasa flow; Yin & Restorative classes
why_its_here: Minutes from the sea in Pererenan, Mission Flow Studio is a light-filled space for yoga and conscious movement, with panoramic windows. Classes cover Vinyasa flow, Yin and Restorative, taught by a rotating roster of experienced teachers.
best_for: Drop-ins and regular practitioners, from strong Vinyasa to gentle Yin or Restorative
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: Moana Fish Eatery
address: Batu Bolong
what_to_order: Bora Bora Poisson Cru; Maui Poke; Manava Tuna Steak
why_its_here: Moana, a Tahitian-Polynesian fish eatery on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong, opens from morning until late. The fresh seafood runs to poke bowls, sashimi, carpaccio, tartare and BBQ fish.
best_for: A casual plate of Tahitian-Polynesian raw fish or poke, any time from morning to late
not_for: A red-meat dinner — the kitchen is built around fish.
full_address: Batu Bolong

name: Mosto Berawa
address: Berawa / Pantai Berawa
what_to_order: Natural wine from the 70+ label list, paired with the seasonal small plates
why_its_here: Mosto is a neo-bistro in Berawa. The room seats around 60, and the list runs to more than 70 natural-wine labels from small producers. Food is ingredient-focused, and it opens evenings only.
best_for: A date, an intimate dinner over natural wine, or a small group of wine lovers
not_for: Large groups or a big beachfront party scene, since the room is compact and seats around 60
full_address: Berawa / Pantai Berawa

name: Motion Cafe
address: Canggu/Berawa
why_its_here: A fitness-focused cafe in the Berawa area from Motion Fitness Foods, built around healthy, customizable meals, meal prep and macro-friendly plates.
best_for: Gym-goers and fitness-minded travellers after clean, protein-forward food or a healthy breakfast
not_for: A rich, indulgent or traditional meal, because the menu is built around macro-friendly plates and meal prep
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

name: Motordibali.com
what_to_order: Honda Vario CW — 50K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Scooter rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers scooters. Honda Vario CW starts at 50K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.
full_address: Jln. Sunset Road, Gang Made No 8, Seminyak, Bali - 80361

name: Murmur Restaurant Lounge
address: Jl. Anggrek No.2, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Murmur is a two-storey all-day restaurant and lounge on Jl. Anggrek, with over a hundred seats and a VIP room for eleven. Tables look over the rice fields at sunset. Breakfast runs to 4pm before the dinner menu starts, and the room stays open to 2am.
best_for: A sunset table over the rice fields, with breakfast until 4pm and dinner after
not_for: Breakfast after 4pm — the kitchen switches to the dinner menu then.
full_address: Jl. Anggrek No.2, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: myCHEF
what_to_order: Wine Pairing — 850K IDR.
why_its_here: Restaurant in Canggu. The kitchen is described as Private Dining, Fine Dining. Wine Pairing is 850K IDR. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A special-occasion dinner, not a quick casual meal.
not_for: A cheap casual meal — the menu starts at 850K IDR.
full_address: Bali

name: Nail Lesss Canggu
address: Badung / Pererenan
what_to_order: Gel & acrylic manicure; classic lash extensions
why_its_here: At Nail Lesss, a nail salon on Jalan Pantai Pererenan, the work is manicures, gel and acrylic extensions and classic eyelash extensions.
best_for: A booked gel or acrylic manicure, or lash extensions, in Pererenan
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: Neighbourhood Food Berawa
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa near Finns
why_its_here: Neighbourhood Food's Berawa cafe and coffee shop, on Jl. Pantai Berawa, keeps daytime hours. It serves slow breakfasts, snacks and simple wholesome dishes made from local produce.
best_for: Brunch, coffee or a healthy, casual daytime meal
not_for: Dinner: the Berawa branch closes at 6pm
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa near Finns

name: Neighbourhood Food Seseh
address: Seseh / Cemagi / Mengwi / Seseh
what_to_order: matcha
why_its_here: Among the Seseh fields, Neighbourhood Food has a local eatery and coffee shop. It serves slow breakfasts, afternoon snacks and weekend dinners, with fresh, simple dishes from local produce.
best_for: A calm breakfast, brunch or coffee away from the crowds, or an easy weekend dinner
not_for: A high-energy party or a beach-club scene. Meals here are slow breakfasts and weekend dinners in the fields
full_address: Seseh / Cemagi / Mengwi / Seseh

name: Nikara Spa Berawa
what_to_order: Balinese Harmony Healing Massage (90 min) — 590K IDR.
why_its_here: Balinese massage, facials and spa packages share the 14-treatment list at Nikara Spa Berawa, a wellness spa in Canggu. The 90-minute Balinese Harmony Healing Massage costs 590K IDR; book on the spa's own site.
best_for: Three and a half hours of treatments in Berawa
not_for: A budget massage. Nothing on the list costs under 500K IDR
full_address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Nirvana Life Bali
address: Berawa / Canggu
why_its_here: Nirvana Life is a fitness and wellness club in Berawa, open 6am–11pm, with a gym, classes and recovery in the same building.
best_for: Training and recovery in one place, open from 6am to 11pm
full_address: Berawa / Canggu

name: Nirvana Strength Tibubeneng
why_its_here: Nirvana Strength, a wellness club on Jl. Pantai Berawa, runs more than 100 classes a week across strength, yoga, pilates, mobility, breathwork and sound. Recovery means ice baths, saunas, steam rooms, hot tubs and pools.
best_for: A day pass covering 20-plus classes and the recovery spa

name: Nomads Haus
why_its_here: Nomads Haus in Canggu is a day spa whose eight treatments include a facial, a sports massage and a Balinese massage. You book on the Nomads Haus site.
best_for: A sports massage or a facial in Canggu

name: Nook Umalas
address: Umalas / Kerobokan / Umalas
what_to_order: Eggs Benedict; Big Nook Burger; Nasi Campur Bali Ayam; pork belly sambal matah; fresh juices and smoothies
why_its_here: An open-air café and restaurant beside the Umalas rice fields, open 8am to 11pm. The menu runs Western and Indonesian all day, from breakfast to late, with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free dishes. Seminyak and its bustle are a short hop away.
best_for: A calm breakfast or brunch looking at rice fields, for couples or a group staying off the strip
not_for: Polished fine dining, a beachfront setting or a night out
full_address: Umalas / Kerobokan / Umalas

name: NÜDE Berawa
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa
why_its_here: At a busy junction on Jl. Pantai Berawa, NÜDE runs a healthy cafe, part of a small Bali group. From breakfast to evening it serves wholesome bowls, salads, wraps, smoothies and coffee.
best_for: Digital nomads and families after a healthy brunch or a casual all-day meal
not_for: A quiet table out of the way, because it sits on a busy Berawa junction
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.86, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

name: Obsidian Gym Bali
address: Canggu
price_text: 1 Day Pass 449k IDR 449k
why_its_here: A premium, design-led Canggu gym with high-end equipment and recovery facilities, open 6am–10pm daily.
best_for: Lifters after top-tier kit, with recovery on site
not_for: A low-cost drop-in: the premium day pass is 449k
full_address: Canggu

name: Oma Jamu
address: Canggu/Berawa
what_to_order: Jamu (traditional herbal tonic)
why_its_here: A budget vegan cafe and organic grocery near the Puseh temple in Batu Bolong. Plant-based Indonesian food runs all day, alongside cold-pressed juices, kombucha and traditional jamu tonics.
best_for: Affordable vegan or vegetarian eating by day, from a healthy breakfast to a jamu tonic
not_for: Diners wanting meat or a full-service dinner, since it is a vegan cafe
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

name: OnBikes
what_to_order: Honda SCOOPY — 100K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Motorbike rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers motorbikes. Honda SCOOPY starts at 100K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.
full_address: Jalan Raya Semat No. 1, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80363, Indonesia

name: One Eyed Jack
address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.c89, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Pantai Berawa No.c89 in Canggu, open daily 3:00-11:00pm.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu; Berawa.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.c89, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali

name: Only Nails Bali
what_to_order: One Finger Repair — 50K IDR.
why_its_here: Only Nails Bali is a nail salon in Canggu with 25 treatments, manicures and pedicures among them. A one-finger repair costs 50K IDR, and you book on the salon's own site.
best_for: A manicure, a pedicure or a one-finger repair
full_address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong

name: Only Nails Pererenan
address: Badung / Pererenan
what_to_order: Russian manicure; long-wear gel
why_its_here: The Russian manicure technique and long-wear gel are the speciality at Only Nails, a nail salon on Jl. Raya Tiyingtutul in Pererenan. A 4-hands service does manicure and pedicure at once, and the space is calm.
best_for: A precise Russian manicure or long-lasting gel, or a quick 4-hands mani-pedi
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: Paed Thai — Canggu
address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.8A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Part of the Wonderspace group, Paed Thai cooks Thai food on Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong. The menu has tom yum goong, pad thai, green curry and mango sticky rice. Indoor and outdoor tables face rice fields.
best_for: Thai food at the end of a Canggu day

name: Paradise Padel Bali
why_its_here: The padel club on Jalan Subak Sari rents equipment and has parking, a shop, a restaurant and changing rooms. Courts book through Playtomic, and a 60-minute session with a coach starts at 900,000 IDR. Tournaments and mixed-level sessions run regularly.
best_for: Padel booked from the phone

name: Pizza Fabbrica
address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
why_its_here: Pizza Fabbrica is a Neapolitan pizzeria on Jl. Batu Mejan, with a second branch in Umalas. The pizzas are wood-fired, thin and light, the pasta is fresh, and the room is industrial in style.
best_for: A casual pizza dinner with friends, family or a group sharing
full_address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa

name: Porch
address: Jl. Raya Semat No.1, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Thirteen kinds of cheesecake are the reason to come to Porch, a coffee shop on Jl. Raya Semat.
best_for: Coffee and cheesecake

name: Poule de Luxe Bali
what_to_order: cream puffs; macarons; caramel/chocolate tart; lemon meringue tart; croissants and pain au chocolat
why_its_here: Poule de Luxe makes cream puffs, macarons, tarts and viennoiserie in its French patisserie and bakery on Jl. Batu Belig. You can eat in or take away. It also supplies desserts to villas and restaurants, and for parties.
best_for: A pastry with coffee, a grab-and-go breakfast, or a letter cake or gift for a celebration
not_for: A full sit-down meal or a savoury dinner, since it bakes pastries and cakes

name: Pranava Yoga
why_its_here: Vicki and Yuni opened Pranava Yoga in April 2016, at the Matrabali guesthouse on Jl. Pantai Berawa. Rates sit below the premium Canggu studios so local residents can practise too, and classes suit every level.
best_for: Yoga at a price the neighbourhood can pay

name: Rasa Kitchen
address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.80A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.80A, open daily 10:00am-11:00pm.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu.
full_address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.80A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Rental Scooter in Canggu
what_to_order: Yamaha Fazzio — 120K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Scooter rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers scooters. Yamaha Fazzio starts at 120K IDR per day. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.
full_address: Jl. Raya Canggu No.88, Badung, Bali

name: reSPAwn Spa Bali
what_to_order: Head massage (60 min) — 250K IDR.
why_its_here: A wellness spa in Canggu with 67 treatments, among them traditional massage, Balinese massage and body treatments. An hour of head massage costs 250K IDR, and the longest treatments run 150 minutes. Book by WhatsApp.
best_for: A head massage on its own, or a Balinese massage

name: Revive Bali
what_to_order: Traditional Balinese Massage (60 min) — 330K IDR.
why_its_here: Revive Bali is a Canggu spa with 50 treatments on its list, from manicures to foot massage and body scrubs. A traditional Balinese massage is 330K IDR for an hour, and bookings go through WhatsApp.
best_for: Getting your nails done, or a foot massage

name: Revolver Canggu
address: Canggu / Central Canggu / shortcut approach
what_to_order: In-house-roasted specialty coffee; the Revolver Big Brekkie.
why_its_here: Revolver, a Bali coffee brand founded in 2012, roasts its own beans; this is its all-day cafe on Jl. Nelayan in Canggu. Espresso and full brunch run by day, heavier plates in the evening, and it turns bar-ish after dark.
best_for: Coffee-led brunch after a surf, a morning on the laptop, or an easy all-day sit-down
not_for: A calm evening meal, since it turns bar-ish after dark
full_address: Canggu / Central Canggu / shortcut approach

name: Rise and Shine Cafe
address: Canggu/Berawa
what_to_order: Breakfast burrito; super scramble; Morning Magic smoothie
why_its_here: Open since 2017 on Jl. Padang Linjong, Rise and Shine is a colourful all-day breakfast and lunch cafe. It serves fresh, health-conscious comfort food with coffee and juices, all in the open air.
best_for: A healthy breakfast or brunch after the beach, for solo travellers, couples and small groups
not_for: Evening dinner or drinks, because it serves breakfast and lunch by day
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

name: Rite Bali
address: Badung / Pererenan
price_text: Day Pass special price null special price
what_to_order: Sauna; cold plunge; jacuzzi and steam room recovery
why_its_here: RITE Bali, a wellness club on Jl. Pantai Pererenan, has a gym, yoga classes and a recovery zone. Recovery pairs a sauna and steam room with a jacuzzi and a 7-9°C cold plunge. A 500k day pass bundles recovery with gym access.
best_for: Athletes and active travellers after training, yoga and contrast recovery in one Pererenan spot
not_for: A traditional pampering spa. Recovery here is sauna, steam room, jacuzzi and cold plunge
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: RITE Bali Recovery
address: Pererenan
price_text: Day Pass 500.000 IDR (tax incl.) - access to Gym & Recovery all day + classes
why_its_here: The recovery-and-spa side of RITE Bali in Pererenan. Sauna, ice bath and bodywork come bundled with gym access on a 500k day pass.
best_for: Fitness travellers pairing training with contrast recovery on one day pass
full_address: Pererenan

name: RITE Bali Yoga
address: Pererenan
why_its_here: The yoga strand of RITE Bali in Pererenan, with classes alongside the club's gym and recovery facilities.
best_for: Members and visitors after yoga bundled with training and recovery
full_address: Pererenan

name: Riviera Bistro Berawa
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa
what_to_order: pasta
why_its_here: Riviera Bistro, open since 2020, is a modern Mediterranean bistro and wine bar in Berawa with whitewashed arches. The wine list is extensive, Aperitivo hour runs daily, and Saturday is DJ night. It opens from late morning until late.
best_for: A date night, aperitivo, or a lively evening of dinner and drinks
not_for: A quiet or budget spot. Evenings here are lively, with a Saturday DJ night
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa

name: Riviera Cafe Cemagi
address: Cemagi / Mengwi / Cemagi
what_to_order: pizza
why_its_here: Riviera Group's garden cafe in quiet Cemagi leans Mediterranean-Italian, with cozy interiors and greenery. Live acoustic music plays on Saturday evenings.
best_for: Calm breakfasts, lunches or evening meals away from the Canggu crowds, or a low-key night for a couple
not_for: Beachfront views or a high-energy party scene: the cafe sits in a garden in quiet Cemagi

not_for: A quiet daytime work session or a beachfront table, because the trattoria room is cozy and lively

why_its_here: Spices are ground daily at Rize, a Pererenan cafe serving contemporary Indian home cooking rooted in family recipes. Brunch classics, craft cocktails and house chai fill out the menu.
best_for: Spice lovers and small groups sharing Indian dishes, a distinctive brunch, or cocktails and chai
not_for: A beach-club or sunset-view scene, because the focus is Indian home cooking
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

why_its_here: An all-day plant-based restaurant in Pererenan for vegans, vegetarians and anyone eating less meat. The menu is built around a bowl you make yourself from 50+ ingredients.
best_for: Plant-based eaters after a bowl built their way, or a casual daytime laptop session
not_for: Meat-centric diners or a formal special-occasion dinner — it is a casual plant-based place

name: Rosies Nail Bar
what_to_order: 30 minute Massage — 150K IDR.
why_its_here: Pedicures, manicures and nails all sit on the 45-treatment list at Rosies Nail Bar, a nail salon in Canggu. A 30-minute massage costs 150K IDR, and you book by WhatsApp.
best_for: A pedicure, or a 30-minute massage

name: Ruko Cafe
address: Canggu/Berawa
what_to_order: Coffee on the house Indonesian blend; pancakes; avocado toast; fresh smoothies
why_its_here: About 300m from Berawa beach, Ruko is an Australian-style neighbourhood cafe for breakfast and brunch. The food is healthy and locally sourced, 40-50% of the produce is local and organic, and the coffee is its own Indonesian blend.
best_for: Families, couples or solo travellers after a fresh, organic-leaning breakfast or brunch and coffee after the beach
not_for: An evening out or dinner: it is a daytime cafe
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

name: S2S Crossfit
why_its_here: S2S is a CrossFit box on Jl. Raya Semat. It runs CrossFit, weightlifting, high-intensity cardio and personal training. A drop-in costs 200,000 IDR with no booking needed; arrive ten minutes before class.
best_for: A drop-in WOD without booking ahead

name: Sa'Mesa Canggu
address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.1e, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
what_to_order: The Experience Dinner set menu (the only format); house-made limoncello
why_its_here: A communal Italian dinner where everyone shares one long table. The multi-course set menu is family-style, inspired by an Italian grandmother's table. There is one seating, dinner only, and you book ahead.
best_for: Communal Italian set-menu dinners at one long shared table, one seating a night
not_for: Walking in — booking only, dinner only, one 7:30pm seating.
full_address: Jl. Canggu Padang Linjong No.1e, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Sababa
address: Jl. Pantai Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu; Berawa.

address: Jl. Raya Semat No.99, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80360
why_its_here: Sama Sama Prime, from the Sama Sama group, combines a steakhouse and a sushi bar on Jl. Raya Semat. Its own site calls it a steakhouse sushi bar on the homepage and a modern premium Japanese restaurant on the about page. We have not settled which.
best_for: Steak and sushi under one roof, on Jl. Raya Semat in Canggu
full_address: Jl. Raya Semat No.99, Tibubeneng, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80360

address: Canggu/Berawa
what_to_order: Superfood smoothie bowls; traditional Indian dishes
why_its_here: Samadi is a yoga and wellness hub on Jl. Padang Linjong, in the Batu Bolong part of Canggu. Its organic vegetarian cafe is certified by the Slow Food movement and serves superfood bowls and traditional Indian dishes.
best_for: A calm, plant-based meal on either side of a yoga class
not_for: Meat, alcohol or a high-energy social scene: the cafe is vegetarian and the hub is built around yoga
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu.

name: Santanera
address: Canggu / Tanah Barak
what_to_order: Baby squid with black garlic mole; dry-aged duck.
why_its_here: On Jl. Tanah Barak, Santanera pairs a Latin American dining room with a rooftop bar. The sharing menu mixes Latin flavours with European technique and local ingredients. Contemporary artwork, a big seated room and a late-night bar make a full evening of it.
best_for: A special evening of rooftop cocktails and shared plates, as a date or with a group
full_address: Canggu / Tanah Barak

name: Satu-Satu Coffee Company
address: Canggu/Berawa
gmaps_url: https://maps.google.com/maps?saddr=&daddr=Jl. Raya Pantai Berawa no. 36, Canggu 80361 Indonesia@-8.655794,115.14754
what_to_order: Espresso or cold brew on their in-house-roasted Indonesian single origins; smoothie bowl (Lady Gaga bowl); ruccola panini; eggs Benedict
why_its_here: Built on the Sudana family's Balinese single-origin beans, roasted in-house, Satu-Satu is a family-run specialty coffee company in Berawa. The bright white space is eco-minded. A simple all-day menu of bowls, sandwiches and smoothies feeds the post-surf crowd.
best_for: Well-pulled espresso from Indonesian single origins for coffee lovers, or a healthy breakfast or lunch bowl after a surf
not_for: An evening out: coffee and brunch here are daytime affairs
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

name: Saya Club
why_its_here: Saya Club combines a gym and coworking space in Berawa. There is personal training, and classes in pilates, reformer, boxing and yoga. On site are an ice bath, a sauna, a pool and a cafe-bar.
best_for: Training

name: Seabird Bistro & Coworking Canggu by Wonderspace
address: Jl. Nelayan No.888B, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Seabird is a bistro and coworking space on Jl. Nelayan, part of the Wonderspace group. The kitchen does Italian comfort food with a French turn, such as grilled lobster tagliatelle, wagyu steak frites and rigatoni vodka. Vegetarian and vegan options sit alongside local wines and cocktails.
best_for: A working morning that turns into lunch

name: Secana Rooftop
address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Tibubeneng, Berawa, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
price_anchor: Pool daybed minimum spend 350K+++ per person
why_its_here: On top of the Secana Beachtown resort in Berawa, Secana Rooftop is a pool bar and restaurant open from morning to 11pm. There are daybeds by day, the menu moves between Mediterranean and comfort cooking, and DJs play sunset sessions on Fridays and Sundays.
best_for: A daybed by the rooftop pool, or a DJ sunset on Friday or Sunday
not_for: A cheap drop-in — pool daybeds carry a 350K++ per-person minimum spend.
full_address: Jl. Pemelisan Agung Jl. Pantai Berawa, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Tibubeneng, Berawa, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

name: Secret Spot
address: Jl. Tanah Barak No. 7, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: vegan croissants; pesto and cheeze croissant; pancakes; full English breakfast; vegan bowls and curries; chicory coffee
why_its_here: Secret Spot is a fully plant-based cafe serving vegan food from breakfast through dinner: croissants, bowls, curries and ramen. The coffee is roasted weekly on the island, with chicory as an alternative. Monday is pasta night, with live jazz.
best_for: Vegan breakfast or brunch of plant-based croissants and pastries, with island-roasted coffee
not_for: Meat or seafood eaters, or a fast grab-and-go stop: the menu is fully plant-based

address: Seseh / Cemagi / Mengwi / Seseh
what_to_order: Milk-based coffee (flat white); sandwiches and salads

not_for: A sit-down dinner or a formal evening out, because the food is breads, sandwiches and salads

address: Pererenan / Pantai Pererenan
why_its_here: Shelter, a wood-fired Middle Eastern and Mediterranean restaurant in Pererenan, is built inside a Balinese joglo with open, plant-filled architecture. A UK chef runs the kitchen, and a rotating calendar brings BBQs and vinyl DJ nights. Booking is recommended.
best_for: Special occasions, date nights and group dinners, booked ahead
not_for: A quick walk-in lunch or a solo laptop session, because reservations are recommended
full_address: Pererenan / Pantai Pererenan

name: Shichirin Japanese Restaurant — Canggu

why_its_here: Shichirin brings Japanese grill cooking to Berawa as part of the Wonderspace group. The menu has teppanyaki, gyukatsu and izakaya plates. Sushi and sashimi are on it too. The house dishes are black cod in saikyo miso and breaded Santuri wagyu.
best_for: A grill dinner with a group

name: Shosan Holistic Spa
what_to_order: Shosan Signature Massage (90 min) — 1100K IDR.

best_for: A head massage booked the same day
not_for: A budget massage: the published list starts at 1100K IDR
full_address: Pererenan, Bali

name: SIA - Grill & Seafood Bar
address: Jl. Subak Canggu, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
why_its_here: SIA is a casual seafood and grill bar on the Canggu Shortcut. Fresh fish meets Balinese ingredients and Asian influences, and there is a cocktail programme.
best_for: Fresh seafood and grill plates with cocktails on the Canggu Shortcut
full_address: Jl. Subak Canggu, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

address: Jl. Raya Semat No.7, Tibubeneng, Kabupaten Badung
what_to_order: Family Dumpling Combo; Salted Duck Egg Fried Rice with Seafood
why_its_here: Sista Dumpling is a modern dumpling bistro on Jl. Raya Semat in Berawa, open from late morning to 11pm. The menu is built around sharing plates, with drinks alongside. There is a second branch in Uluwatu; the details here are for the Berawa room.
best_for: Shared dumplings and drinks from late morning
not_for: A late booking — last reservation is 10pm, taken two hours ahead.
full_address: Jl. Raya Semat No.7, Tibubeneng, Kabupaten Badung

why_its_here: Six Senses Spas in Canggu is a wellness spa with 16 treatments, among them Javanese lulur, deep tissue and traditional massage.

why_its_here: SKOOL Kitchen is an open-flame kitchen on Jl. Pura Dalem that cooks meats and seafood over wood and charcoal. Dinner only, from 5pm: a tasting menu, à la carte plates and cuts priced by weight. It shares an address with The Lawn Canggu, another Project Black venue.
best_for: A special-occasion or date-night dinner by the beach, with drinks
not_for: Daytime plans, since it opens at 5pm daily
full_address: Batu Bolong Beach, Canggu

why_its_here: SMOKE cooks open-fire barbecue at Echo Beach, with seating outdoors, in a tent or indoors. It also has a private backyard barn and a chef's table, for groups of ten or more booked 48 hours ahead.
best_for: Open-fire barbecue at Echo Beach, in the tent, indoors or in the garden
not_for: Booking the garden or deck — reservations cover tent and indoor only.

name: Spring Spa Canggu
address: Batu Bolong / Canggu

best_for: A walk-in mani-pedi or a quick massage between beach and brunch, without a hotel-spa booking
full_address: Batu Bolong / Canggu

name: Surya Fitness Gym
why_its_here: A gym and fight club in Pererenan, Surya Fitness uses Life Fitness, Hammer Strength and TechnoGym equipment. The fight club runs boxing, Muay Thai, pad work and sparring. On site are a stretching rooftop and a cafe, plus billiards.
best_for: Lifting and striking under one roof, with air conditioning, water, towels, showers and lockers in the membership

name: Sushimi Bali

why_its_here: On Jl. Pantai Berawa, Sushimi's sushi train carries classic and creative sushi and maki, plus an izakaya-style a la carte range. The menu extends to poke bowls, donburi, sushi burritos and sushi donuts. There are gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian options.
best_for: Casual sushi off the train, with friends, on your own or with a group of mixed diets
not_for: A formal or high-end omakase, a quiet intimate dinner or a sea view, because this is a casual sushi train

name: Swara Spa

why_its_here: Avocado runs through the whole menu at The Avocado Factory, a cafe. Dishes run from truffle eggs benedict to avo pancakes and avocado basque cheesecake, in an eco-conscious build.

name: The Lawn Canggu Beach Club

name: The Shady Shack
address: Canggu/Berawa
why_its_here: From the team behind Betelnut, The Shady Shack is an all-day vegetarian and vegan cafe looking over the Berawa rice fields. The wholefood menu is big: all-day breakfast, smoothies, salads, share plates and vegan desserts, in a leafy, open setting.
best_for: Plant-based eaters, from a healthy brunch after a surf to an early dinner with a rice-field view
not_for: Diners set on meat or seafood, because the menu is entirely vegetarian and vegan
full_address: Canggu/Berawa

name: The Slow
address: Canggu
why_its_here: The restaurant, bar and gallery inside The Slow, a design-led boutique hotel on Batu Bolong. The kitchen is internationally inspired and runs all day, and the room doubles as an art and events space. It works for breakfast as well as an evening out.
best_for: A design-led brunch or dinner inside The Slow hotel on Batu Bolong
not_for: A standalone street venue — it sits inside The Slow hotel.
full_address: Canggu

name: Therapy Canggu
address: Batu Bolong / Canggu
why_its_here: The Batu Bolong flagship of the Therapy group, open 9am to 8pm, with massage, facials and beauty treatments in a calm space.
best_for: Spa and beauty treatments together, near the Batu Bolong strip
full_address: Batu Bolong / Canggu

name: Therapy Day Spa
what_to_order: Reflexology (30 min) — 300K IDR.
why_its_here: Therapy Day Spa is a Canggu spa whose 21 treatments include scalp treatments, cream baths and spa packages. Treatments last up to three hours, and 30 minutes of reflexology costs 300K IDR. Book by WhatsApp.
best_for: Thirty minutes of reflexology, a cream bath or a scalp treatment

name: Therapy Day Spa Pererenan
address: Badung / Pererenan
what_to_order: Balinese and toxin-free massages; facials; body scrubs; scalp rituals
why_its_here: Therapy Day Spa on Jl. Pantai Pererenan is built around plant-derived rituals that are toxin-free and cruelty-free. Massages, facials, body scrubs and scalp treatments run in a calm setting.
best_for: A natural, clean-ingredient massage or facial in a calm Pererenan setting
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: Therapy Hair & Spa Canggu
address: Canggu
why_its_here: The Therapy group's Canggu salon, open 9am to 8pm, pairs hairdressing with spa-style facials and massage. On the hair side there are cuts, colour and blow-outs.
best_for: Hair and beauty under one roof, near Batu Bolong
full_address: Canggu

name: Think Pink Nails Canggu
address: Canggu
why_its_here: A Canggu branch of Think Pink, doing manicures, pedicures and playful nail art at friendly prices.
best_for: A quick, well-priced mani-pedi between the beach and a café
full_address: Canggu

name: Tonic Canggu
what_to_order: Super Relaxing Foot Massage (60 min) — 250K IDR.
why_its_here: Deep tissue, traditional and Balinese massage are among the 45 treatments at Tonic Canggu, a day spa. A one-hour foot massage costs 250K IDR, the longest treatments run three hours, and you book on the spa's own website.
best_for: Deep tissue, or the one-hour foot massage
full_address: Jl. Batu Mejan, Canggu, Badung, Bali

name: Tonic Day Spa & Botanicals
address: Berawa / Canggu
why_its_here: A Berawa day spa with a botanicals-led treatment menu, from massage to facials.
best_for: Visitors who want a natural, botanical-focused spa afternoon in Berawa.
full_address: Berawa / Canggu

name: Top Gym
why_its_here: A 400-square-metre boutique gym near Batu Bolong, Top Gym has rice field views and TechnoGym equipment throughout. The recovery area has a panoramic terrace, two ice baths, a sauna, a smoothie bar and loungers.
best_for: Training and recovery in one stop, with group classes in stretching, yoga, pilates, functional training, boxing and dance

name: Touché Cafe & Restaurant
address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pererenan north
what_to_order: pancake — note: one review reported a hair in the pancake — an isolated report, not the overall pattern
why_its_here: Near Pererenan beach, Touché keeps all-day cafe hours from early morning to late, with design-led interiors and an urban-leaning menu.
best_for: Brunch among design-led interiors, a daytime coffee with the laptop, or a casual meal
not_for: A beach-club scene or a big group party: it is an all-day cafe
full_address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pererenan north

name: Tropical Nomad
address: Canggu / Canggu shortcut / Subak Canggu
why_its_here: Tropical Nomad is a coworking space on the Canggu shortcut with an open-air cafe built in that looks over rice fields and a garden. It is made for eating, sitting with a laptop and staying a while.
best_for: Digital nomads and remote workers after fast wifi and big shared tables, or a casual daytime coffee
not_for: A romantic dinner or a special-occasion night out, because this is a coworking space with a cafe
full_address: Canggu / Canggu shortcut / Subak Canggu

name: Turntable Canggu | Steakhouse
address: Jl. Raya Babakan Canggu No.51, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jl. Raya Babakan Canggu No.51, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu.
full_address: Jl. Raya Babakan Canggu No.51, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: TWO FACE Canggu
address: Canggu / Munduk Catu
what_to_order: Specialty coffee; brunch classics
why_its_here: Well-made coffee and creative brunch dishes are the focus at TWO FACE, a specialty coffee and brunch cafe on Jl. Munduk Catu in Canggu. It has a community feel.
best_for: A morning brunch and specialty coffee in a welcoming space
not_for: Late-night diners; the kitchen is a daytime brunch operation.
full_address: Canggu / Munduk Catu

name: Tyce Spa Bali
what_to_order: Foot Massage (60 min) — 160K IDR.
why_its_here: Waxing sits next to traditional massage and foot massage on the 85-treatment list at Tyce Spa Bali, a wellness spa in Canggu. An hour of foot massage costs 160K IDR, and the longest treatments run two hours. Bookings are taken on the spa's own website.
best_for: Waxing, or a foot massage at 160K IDR

name: Udara Bali
address: Badung / Seseh (Adjacent Pererenan)
why_its_here: Organic Ocean, the plant-forward restaurant at the Udara wellness retreat in Seseh, is open daily to guests and visitors. The cooking is healthy and conscious of community and earth.
best_for: Health-minded diners after a quiet, restorative and organic meal near the beach
not_for: A lively nightlife scene or a heavy meat-and-cocktails night out: the kitchen is plant-forward
full_address: Badung / Seseh (Adjacent Pererenan)

name: Udara Bali Spa
opening_hours: Daily 10 am - 9 pm (last treatment starts at 7:45 pm)
what_to_order: Foot Massage (60 min) — 540K IDR.
why_its_here: Udara Bali Spa is a Canggu day spa whose 20 treatments include Balinese massage, deep tissue and foot massage. A 60-minute foot massage is 540K IDR, and the longest sessions last two and a half hours. Book by WhatsApp.
best_for: A Balinese or deep tissue massage

name: Udara Bali Yoga Detox & Spa / Organic Ocean
address: Seseh / Mengwi / Seseh
what_to_order: Yoga & detox retreat; sound healing in the Quantum Sound Domes; spa treatments
why_its_here: At Seseh Beach, Udara Bali is a yoga, detox and wellness retreat resort for adults only (14+). It has five ocean-view yoga shalas and Quantum Sound Domes for sound healing. Its spa has a water-healing pool; there are seawater pools too, and the plant-forward Organic Ocean restaurant.
best_for: A yoga or detox retreat, sound healing or a spa day in a quiet adults-only setting by the ocean
not_for: Families with young children or a lively town-centre base, because it is adults-only (14+) and out at Seseh Beach
full_address: Seseh / Mengwi / Seseh

name: Ulekan Berawa
address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa
what_to_order: Beef Rendang; Sate Ayam; Gado Gado.
why_its_here: Ulekan, a sit-down Indonesian restaurant in Berawa, cooks dishes from across the archipelago. Spices are ground by hand and there is no MSG or palm oil; ingredients come from small-scale farmers and fishermen. Tables sit in a fairy-lit garden.
best_for: A sit-down dinner of classic Indonesian dishes, shared as a group or as an accessible introduction to the cuisine
full_address: Tibubeneng / Canggu / Berawa

name: Uma Garden
why_its_here: Restaurant in Canggu. The kitchen is described as wood-fire. The published menu includes Wood-fire steaks, Pasta and Seafood. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: Wood-fire in Canggu.
full_address: Umalas, Bali

name: UMALAS
what_to_order: BALINESE full body massage (60 min) — 400K IDR.
why_its_here: UMALAS is a massage studio in Canggu with 13 treatments, traditional massage and spa packages among them. A full-body Balinese massage costs 400K IDR for 60 minutes, and booking is on the studio's own website.
best_for: Traditional massage or a spa package

name: Urban Bites Cafe at Berawa
address: Jalan Raya Semat Tibubeneng, berawa, Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jalan Raya Semat Tibubeneng in Canggu, open daily 7:00am-11:00pm.
best_for: Travellers looking for a current place to eat in Canggu; Berawa.
full_address: Jalan Raya Semat Tibubeneng, berawa, Canggu, Kuta Utara, Badung Regency, Bali 80361

name: Urban Oasis
what_to_order: THAI FLOW (60 min) — 550K IDR.
why_its_here: Urban Oasis keeps its Canggu day spa list short: five treatments, among them a spa package, Thai massage and recovery sessions. An hour of Thai Flow is 550K IDR; book on the venue's own website.
best_for: Thai massage or a recovery session
full_address: Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.113, Pererenan, Kec. Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351

name: Victory Fitness Club
why_its_here: Open daily 07:00-20:30, Victory Fitness Club is a budget gym at Jl. Pantai Pererenan No.89. Equipment spreads over two floors, with a punching bag and loan gloves upstairs and a smoothie bar below. An ice bath and sauna are on site.
best_for: Cheap, no-frills lifting with ice bath and sauna, at around EUR 3 for the day

name: Vore Grillhouse and Lounge
address: Jalan Pantai Berawa No.34, Tibubeneng, Canggu, Bali 80361
why_its_here: Restaurant on Jalan Pantai Berawa No.34 in Canggu.
best_for: Travellers who want to check availability and reserve a table through Chope.
full_address: Jalan Pantai Berawa No.34, Tibubeneng, Canggu, Bali 80361

name: Wahdah
what_to_order: Toyota Yaris 1.5 (A) — 387K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Car rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers cars. Toyota Yaris 1.5 (A) starts at 387K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a family or group needing a car, not just a scooter.
not_for: Riders without a valid driving licence — the venue states one is required.

name: Wanderlust Fitness Village
address: Canggu / Padonan
price_text: 1 Day ALL-INCLUSIVE Pass 350,000 IDR 350,000 IDR
why_its_here: A sprawling open-air fitness village in Padonan with gym, functional zones, classes and a café, on an all-inclusive day-pass model (350k).
best_for: A full day of varied training in one spot, with a community feel
full_address: Canggu / Padonan

name: Warung Babi Guling Swari
why_its_here: Warung Babi Guling Swari serves Balinese roast pork with crispy skin and bumbu genep. Its official links list a Canggu branch and ordering through GrabFood, GoFood and ShopeeFood.
best_for: A straightforward babi guling stop in Canggu
not_for: Vegetarian or halal diners, or anyone avoiding pork, since babi guling is roast pork

name: Warung Bu Mi
address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
what_to_order: Nasi campur (build-your-own plate) — note: one review reported food poisoning after this dish — an isolated report, not the overall pattern; the house sambal
why_its_here: A warung in Batu Bolong serving Indonesian home-style food. Its official profile lists service from 09:00 to 22:00 and says all the food is halal.
best_for: An Indonesian home-style meal in Batu Bolong
not_for: A formal multi-course dinner: this is a home-style warung
full_address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa

name: Warung Jawa Bu Sri
what_to_order: nasi campur (Javanese-style mixed rice); tempe and tofu sides; sayur; sambal; fried or grilled chicken
why_its_here: A small family-run warung cooking Javanese-Balinese home-style nasi campur for lunch. It is semi-indoor with street views, open roughly 10am–5pm and closed on Sundays.
best_for: An unfussy nasi campur lunch near Padang Linjong or Echo Beach, with plenty of veg options
not_for: Dinner, a Sunday, or a large group that needs table space — it is a small lunch-only warung, closed on Sundays

name: Warung Local
what_to_order: nasi campur; nasi goreng; chicken satay; mie goreng; sambal
why_its_here: Warung Local is a semi-open Indonesian warung on the Batu Bolong strip, open daily 10am to 10pm. The kitchen is Halal and cooks local staples such as nasi campur, nasi goreng and satay, and there is an outdoor seating section.
best_for: Halal diners after familiar local staples, at lunch or a casual dinner in central Batu Bolong
not_for: Pork dishes or a quiet, no-scene warung: the kitchen is Halal and it sits on the Batu Bolong strip

name: Warung Nonii
address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa
what_to_order: Nasi campur
why_its_here: Just up from the beach on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong sits Warung Nonii, also written Waroeng Nonii, an affordable Indonesian warung. It is open from breakfast through dinner, nasi campur is the house plate, and takeaway is available.
best_for: A cheap, easy local meal at any time of day, including a low-key dinner straight off the plane
full_address: Canggu/Batu Bolong/Berawa

name: Warung Sika
what_to_order: nasi campur (mixed rice, self-selected); fried chicken; BBQ chicken; mie goreng; sambal
why_its_here: Family-run Warung Sika serves nasi campur, open daily 9am to 9pm. It is point-and-pick: you choose rice, then add vegetables and meats from the display.
best_for: Solo diners and first-timers after a cheap, build-your-own nasi campur lunch in an English-friendly setup
not_for: Table service or a quiet sit-down dinner, because the room is busy and canteen-style

name: Warung Varuna
what_to_order: nasi campur (self-selected plate); nasi goreng; satay chicken; tempe and tofu sides; fresh banana juice
why_its_here: A buffet-style Indonesian warung with 30-plus dishes in a glass case. You build a plate of rice, proteins and vegetables at low prices, any day from 8am to 10pm.
best_for: Budget eaters near Batu Bolong beach, and vegetarian or mixed groups who like to see the dishes before they pick
not_for: Diners who want food cooked hot to order rather than served from a display

name: Warung Yess
what_to_order: nasi campur (mixed rice, self-selected); sambal matah; grilled or fried chicken; sayur (vegetable sides); tempe
why_its_here: A nasi campur warung in Pererenan with indoor and garden seating. You build a mixed-rice plate from the day's fresh display, and the warung has its own sambal matah.
best_for: A sit-down garden lunch of nasi campur and sambal matah, for anyone staying on the Pererenan side
not_for: Western dishes or a night out at a bar: this is a nasi campur warung

name: Watercress Berawa
address: Opposite Bali Equestrian Centre, Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali, Indonesia
why_its_here: Watercress Berawa is an all-day café in Tibubeneng serving breakfast, brunch and international dishes.
best_for: An easy breakfast or brunch in Berawa
full_address: Opposite Bali Equestrian Centre, Berawa, Tibubeneng, Kuta Utara, Badung, Bali, Indonesia

name: Wave House Bali
why_its_here: Wave House Bali is a day spa in Canggu with five treatments, including Balinese massage, body scrubs and Javanese lulur. Bookings go through its own website.
best_for: Javanese lulur or a body scrub

name: Wish Bali Motorbike Rental
what_to_order: Honda Scoopy — 50K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Vehicle rental in Canggu. The published fleet covers scooters and motorbikes. Honda Scoopy starts at 50K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is on the venue's own site.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.

name: Woods Bali
address: Badung / Pererenan
why_its_here: Built entirely from reclaimed wood, Woods is a rustic Pererenan restaurant cooking a Mediterranean menu in a warm, greenery-filled chalet. It runs as a cafe by day and a dinner room by night, with live jazz and vinyl evenings.
best_for: A cosy dinner or a date night, or a group evening with live music
full_address: Badung / Pererenan

name: Workmates Coworking Space & Cafe
address: Gg. Bonton No.8A, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80363, Indonesia
why_its_here: Workmates is a coworking space and cafe in Canggu, part of the Wonderspace group. Desks and fast wifi come with a poolside view. The kitchen does chicken parmigiana, Indonesian plates and bowls.
best_for: A full day of work with lunch on site

name: Wrong Gym Pererenan
address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pererenan north
what_to_order: Gym & functional classes; sauna & ice-bath recovery
why_its_here: Opened in 2023 on Jl. Pantai Pererenan, The Wrong Gym is an all-inclusive gym and lifestyle club. It has a large outdoor training area, a functional jungle gym and fitness classes. Recovery means sauna, ice bath, pool, yoga and spa.
best_for: Digital nomads and fitness-focused travellers on a longer Pererenan stay, after a full-service gym with classes and recovery
not_for: A budget drop-in or a purely passive spa visit: the club is all-inclusive and built around training
full_address: Pererenan / Mengwi / Pererenan north

name: Yema Kitchen
address: Jl. Tanah Barak No.31, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia
price_anchor: Mains 110-295K · Tajine 155-320K · plus 11% tax and 6% service
what_to_order: Gran'ma Chicken Tajine (155K); Couscous Royal (250K); Duck Pastilla (290K)
why_its_here: A café and restaurant on Jl. Tanah Barak, Yema Kitchen runs as a café by day and a bar by night. It calls itself Mediterranean but cooks closer to North African and Levantine: tajine, couscous, pastilla, shawarma and pide.
best_for: Tajine, couscous or pastilla, at the café by day or the bar by night
not_for: A smoke-free room — shisha is a priced line on the menu.
full_address: Jl. Tanah Barak No.31, Canggu, Kec. Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80351, Indonesia

best_for: A date night, special occasion or group dinner with cocktails
not_for: A budget meal or a walk-in at any hour: reservations are recommended
full_address: Canggu / Batu Bolong Beach

name: ZIN Cafe Canggu

what_to_order: House-roasted organic coffee; healthy breakfast plates
why_its_here: ZIN is an open-air bamboo cafe near Nelayan Beach that doubles as a free coworking space. Most tables have power outlets, the wifi is fast and there is a quiet upper room. The coffee is organic and roasted in-house.
best_for: Remote workers and digital nomads working over breakfast and coffee, or a calm, healthy meal near the beach
not_for: A lively bar scene or a fully quiet fine-dining room: people come here to work

why_its_here: A Denpasar kitchen that specialises in ayam betutu: Gilimanuk-style chicken slow-cooked in Balinese spice paste until it falls off the bone. It is a focused, no-frills local place where the betutu and the sambals are the reason to come.
best_for: A spice-forward Balinese lunch where residents eat, away from the tourist strip

best_for: Anyone who wants a hot stone massage

name: Massimo — Italian Restaurant
address: Sanur

best_for: Families and groups after familiar Italian food at a casual sit-down dinner, or a stop for gelato

name: Maya Sanur Fitness Centre
why_its_here: Maya Sanur Resort & Spa has an air-conditioned fitness centre with cardio and strength machines, free for in-house guests. The property is beachfront, with the resort's long lagoon pool and four restaurants.

name: Maya Sanur Spa
address: Central-south beachfront
what_to_order: 90-minute Pure Indulgence (foot ritual, full-body massage, plus facial or foot massage)
why_its_here: Maya Sanur Resort & Spa's beachfront spa has six private double suites in a garden. Certified therapists do traditional massage, body scrubs and facials.
best_for: Couples after a polished resort-spa treatment by the beach, or a massage and facial together
full_address: Central-south beachfront

name: Maya Sanur Yoga Studio
why_its_here: An air-conditioned, contemporary yoga studio at Maya Sanur Resort & Spa, free for in-house guests at any level. Programmes run from free style and restorative to aqua yoga and sun salutation, with daily sessions also on the beachfront plaza and the rooftop garden.
best_for: Resort guests who want a free daily class, indoors in the cool or out on the plaza or roof

name: Mercure Bali Sanur Resort
what_to_order: Reflexology Treatment (45 min) — 299K IDR.
why_its_here: The wellness spa at Mercure Bali Sanur Resort does reflexology and traditional massage, and 45 minutes of reflexology costs 299K IDR. Book on the resort's own site.
best_for: Reflexology at the end of a walking day in Sanur

best_for: Families and long-stay visitors who want an easy all-rounder with familiar Indonesian dishes
not_for: A special occasion or fine dining, because this is a casual cafe

best_for: An upscale beachfront dinner as a couple or for a special occasion, Sunday brunch with a group, or an early family meal

why_its_here: A yoga and retreat centre in a beachfront shala made of 100% bamboo, on Mertasari beach in south Sanur. Open since 2010 and accredited by Yoga Alliance, it runs daily classes, teacher trainings and holistic treatments, with an organic cafe on site.

best_for: A sit-down dinner of Balinese classics with table service, for families and small groups
not_for: Grab-and-go, a fast counter meal or a street-stall budget. This is a sit-down warung with table service

name: Prime Plaza Hotel Sanur Fitness Centre
why_its_here: Prime Plaza Hotel Sanur's gym is open to the public; hotel guests train free. Walk-ins pay 100,000 IDR at peak and 75,000 IDR off peak, which includes a locker, hot and cold showers and spa access. The gym has treadmills and stationary bikes alongside free weights and machines. Personal trainers can be booked ahead by the hour or by the day or week. The property also has a sauna and a hot tub, plus a 110-metre pool.
best_for: A cheap walk-in workout in Sanur, with locker, shower and spa access in the entry price

name: Puri Santrian Spa
address: South Sanur
why_its_here: The spa at Puri Santrian, a family-owned beach resort in south Sanur, has nine double treatment rooms. The menu covers Balinese massage, aromatherapy, reflexology and facials, using Phytomer and Sothys products.
best_for: Classic or modern treatments at a beachfront resort, or a massage paired with its morning beach yoga
full_address: South Sanur

name: Puri Santrian Yoga / Wellness

best_for: Resort guests who want an unhurried free class on the beach in the morning
not_for: A studio workout, since the class is gentle stretching and breathing on the beach

why_its_here: Rip Curl's surf school is on Sanur beach inside the Prama Sanur Beach hotel and has run since 1998. It also teaches kitesurfing, stand-up paddle, windsurfing, wakeboarding, diving and foiling, with certification and rentals. The Little Ripper programme is for under-13s.

best_for: A quieter beach than central Sanur, the Mertasari temple used for melukat bathing, or a flat jogging route through rice fields

best_for: Spicy Sulawesi cooking for a budget lunch, solo or self-serve
not_for: Anyone who dislikes heat and spice, or wants table service and a polished room. It's a self-service warung

name: Warung Babi Guling Pak Malen
what_to_order: nasi campur babi guling; crispy pork skin (kulit); pork satay; lawar; pork soup

not_for: Halal or vegetarian diners, or anyone after air-con and space: this is a pork-only warung

name: Warung Eny's

not_for: Large groups, since the space is small, or diners after a fast in-and-out or a fixed printed menu

name: Warung Melati

best_for: Halal diners, or anyone after simple home-style Javanese food, ideally at lunch around 12–1pm
not_for: Late-night diners or anyone after Balinese pork dishes, because the kitchen winds down by early evening and it is halal, with no pork

full_address: Hidden Hills Villas, Uluwatu

why_its_here: Tea Tree Spa is the day spa at Holiday Inn Resort Baruna Bali, in the Bukit. Its four treatments include Balinese massage, acupressure and a facial, and an hour of Balinese massage is 800K IDR. Book by WhatsApp.
best_for: A Balinese massage at Tea Tree Spa

name: HUMANS CAFE
address: 55J6+93R, Jl. Bali Cliff, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: HUMANS CAFE, on Jl. Bali Cliff in Ungasan, serves Asian, Indonesian and European plates with specialty coffee. There's a playground for children.
best_for: Coffee while the children have somewhere to go

name: Island Grooming Barbershop
why_its_here: A men's barbershop for precision cuts, fades and grooming, with shops on Jl. Labuansait in Pecatu and on Jl. Pantai Bingin.
best_for: A haircut, fade or beard trim near Uluwatu town or Bingin beach

name: KALA Uluwatu
address: Uluwatu/Bukit
what_to_order: wood-fired flatbreads; feta tempura; lamb
why_its_here: A modern Greek neighbourhood grill that opened in 2024 near Padang-Padang Beach in Pecatu, cooking Greek and Mediterranean dishes over an open wood fire in a minimalist wood-and-rattan room with an open kitchen.
best_for: A relaxed sit-down dinner of grilled seafood, souvlaki and mezze for those wanting Mediterranean food rather than Balinese while in the Bukit.
full_address: Uluwatu/Bukit

name: Karma Spa
what_to_order: SIGNATURE ROYAL MASSAGE (75 min) — 350K IDR.
why_its_here: Karma Spa, a day spa in the Bukit, has 18 treatments, from traditional and Balinese massage to the sauna, the longest treatment lasting three hours. The Signature Royal Massage runs 75 minutes and costs 350K IDR, and you book on the spa's own website.
best_for: A couple treatment, or time in the sauna
full_address: Jl. Villa Kandara, Banjar Wijaya Kusuma Ungasan, Bali 80362, Indonesia

name: Karma Spa at Karma Kandara
why_its_here: Karma Kandara's clifftop spa in Ungasan, high above the ocean, with a sauna and a saltwater pool. Treatments run from massages and facials to biohacking-style options.
best_for: A full spa day with cliff views and use of the sauna and pool

name: KO Japanese Restaurant, Teppanyaki and Sushi
address: Uluwatu St No.45, Jimbaran, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361
what_to_order: teppanyaki seafood; sushi; grilled meats
why_its_here: Chef Mitsuaki Senoo runs the Japanese restaurant at the InterContinental Bali Resort in Jimbaran. Teppanyaki is grilled at open counters, there's a sushi and sashimi bar, and a private tatami room sits inside a Balinese-Japanese interior.
best_for: A couple or a group sharing a teppanyaki dinner at the counter, or sushi from the bar
full_address: Uluwatu St No.45, Jimbaran, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361

name: Kokoon Uluwatu at VANARA Resort & Spa
address: Jl. Batu Nunggalan, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80362
full_address: Jl. Batu Nunggalan, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80362

name: La Joya
why_its_here: La Joya, a resort spa in the Bukit, does a couple massage, and you book on its own site.
best_for: Couples booking a massage together

name: La Terrazza Uluwatu
address: 53MQ+VFW, Jl. Pantai Suluban Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Italian restaurant on the cliff above Suluban, started by two Italians from Pisa. Chef Lucia Nicolo works Italian tradition alongside international dishes. Tables sit at the cliff edge, so the pizza arrives with an ocean view. Breakfast through dinner, with a happy hour between.
best_for: Pizza at the cliff edge before sunset

name: La Tribu Bali
why_its_here: A yoga and movement studio near Bingin, on Jl. Buana Sari in Pecatu, that also runs art workshops such as pottery and painting. It teaches handstands and arm balances as well as vinyasa, yin and mobility.
best_for: Playful classes for the movement-curious, with a pottery or painting workshop on the side

name: Laggas Uluwatu
address: Uluwatu/Bukit
what_to_order: dumplings; noodles; slow-cooked ribs
why_its_here: An Asian-fusion restaurant on Jalan Pantai Bingin in Pecatu, in a casual, airy room; evolved from the former Fat Gajah (originally opened by the late Chef Agung Nugroho) and now run as Laggas by Chef Yudi, with a menu of dumplings and gyoza, noodles, salads and slow-cooked ribs, and tuna noodles among the signature plates.
best_for: A relaxed, well-priced sit-down dinner of shareable Asian dishes while staying around Bingin and the Bukit.
full_address: Uluwatu/Bukit

name: LaiA Spa
why_its_here: LaiA Spa is a massage studio in the Bukit, and bookings for its 23 treatments go through WhatsApp. Traditional massage, Balinese massage and deep tissue are among them.
best_for: A traditional or deep-tissue massage in the Bukit
full_address: Jl. Raya Uluwatu Pecatu No.86, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

name: Lemanjá Uluwatu
address: Jl. Labuansait No.168, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Breakfast at Lemanjá Uluwatu starts at 07:30. It's a café, bar and coworking space with a pool on Jl. Labuansait. Plates start at 20,000 IDR, and the menu runs to pan-grilled prawns, tuna tataki, vegan quesadillas and plant-based pizza, with pastries alongside the cocktails.
best_for: An early breakfast before the surf

name: Lola’s Cantina Mexicana — Uluwatu
address: Jl. Labuansait No.10, Pecatu, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
what_to_order: taco
why_its_here: Lola’s Cantina Uluwatu is a Mexican restaurant in Pecatu serving tacos, cocktails and vegetarian options.
best_for: Groups and couples after a casual Mexican meal in Uluwatu
full_address: Jl. Labuansait No.10, Pecatu, Kuta Selatan, Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia

name: Luhur Spa
what_to_order: Head Massage (60 min) — 210K IDR.
why_its_here: Luhur Spa in the Bukit lists 48 treatments, with foot massage, Balinese massage and spa packages among them; the longest treatment runs four hours. An hour-long head massage costs 210K IDR. To book, message the spa on WhatsApp.
best_for: A foot massage when the walking is done, or an hour of head massage

name: Made’s Bakery Cafe Playground
address: Jl. Dharmawangsa No.85, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Made’s Bakery Cafe Playground grew out of a small warung and has been a bakery and café on Jl. Dharmawangsa in Ungasan since 2025. Expect pastries, desserts and coffee, breakfast all day in large portions, and a playground that is free to use.
best_for: Families who need the children occupied

name: Mana Uluwatu
address: Pecatu / uluwatu bukit
what_to_order: pork belly tacos; tuna nachos; beef rendang
why_its_here: A clifftop restaurant, bar and infinity pool set within the Uluwatu Surf Villas complex above Suluban Beach on the Bukit, built as an open-air reclaimed-wood pavilion with daybeds and ocean views; it serves a contemporary fusion menu drawing on Mexican, Asian and South American cooking — more a relaxed all-day sundowner and poolside spot than a party venue.
best_for: Couples and small groups wanting a laid-back afternoon by the pool and a sunset dinner over the ocean.
full_address: Pecatu / uluwatu bukit

name: Mantra Wellness
why_its_here: A short walk from Padang Padang beach, this wellness centre pairs yoga and pilates with a sauna, cold plunge and mandala pool for recovery. There's a healthy cafe and coworking too, and the rooms on site are adults-only.
best_for: Recovery after a surf session
not_for: A family stay: the rooms on site are adults-only

name: Mantra Wellness Bali
why_its_here: Mantra Wellness Bali is a wellness spa in the Bukit with Balinese and traditional massage, plus yoga. You book on its website.
best_for: Massage or yoga at a wellness spa in the Bukit
full_address: Jl. Umpang Sari Padang Padang, Pecatu, South Kuta, Badung Regency, Bali 80361

name: MASONRY Restaurant
address: Uluwatu/Bukit
why_its_here: The Uluwatu outpost of Bali's Masonry, a Mediterranean-leaning bar and grill by group chef Benjamin Cross, working an open wood-fire kitchen for house-cured charcuterie and made-in-house cheeses alongside dishes like 48-hour short rib and wood-roasted lamb shoulder; it sits on Jalan Labuansait in Pecatu, in a concrete-and-stone room by designer Kelvin Ho, with a curated wine list and cocktails.
best_for: A relaxed but polished dinner or long lunch for those who want a wood-fired grill, charcuterie and wine over a beach-club scene.
full_address: Uluwatu/Bukit

name: Morning Light Yoga Studio
why_its_here: An open-air shala of reclaimed teak at Uluwatu Surf Villas, on the clifftop above Balangan and the Uluwatu coastline. There is one morning class a day, each day in a different style, with a free coconut afterwards at the Mana cafe.
best_for: A scenic sunrise class on the clifftop, with ocean views
not_for: A full studio timetable: there is one class a day

name: Mû Boutique Resort

name: NAYA Uluwatu

name: Nelayan Restaurant and Puri Bar at Jimbaran Puri, A Belmond Hotel, Bali

what_to_order: seafood Indo-Med/French; cocktails
why_its_here: Belmond Jimbaran Puri's open-air restaurant and bar sit right on the sand of Jimbaran Bay. Nelayan grills seafood and cooks Mediterranean dishes with Indonesian spices and French technique. At Puri Bar, tropical cocktails and local arak come with the sunset across the bay.
best_for: Couples and resort guests after a sunset cocktail or an unhurried seafood dinner, calmer than Jimbaran's crowded grill row

what_to_order: satay; churros; cocktails
why_its_here: A clifftop day club set about 162 metres above the Indian Ocean within The Edge resort in Pecatu, on the Bukit peninsula, known for its glass-bottom infinity pool that extends roughly 6 metres out over the cliff edge; it runs a food-and-cocktail menu by day and shifts to a slower lounge mood in the late afternoon.
best_for: Couples and groups after a swim-and-sundowner day at a cliff-edge pool; book ahead and arrive before sunset.
full_address: Banjar Dinas Kangin Jl. Pura, Uluwatu, Jl. Goa Lempeh, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
