name: Ours Bali
why_its_here: Ours Bali is an all-day restaurant and bar on the Bukit. Happy hour runs 4–6pm daily, with discounted cocktails and wines, and you book on the venue's own website.
best_for: Discounted cocktails and wine at happy hour
full_address: Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu, Uluwatu, Bali 80361

name: Ours Spa & Boutique
why_its_here: Dermalogica facials, nails, hair and massage at a neighbourhood day spa on Jalan Labuan Sait, with a sister cafe next door. It works largely with vegan and cruelty-free product lines.
best_for: Facials, nails and beauty services with a massage, without leaving the Uluwatu strip

name: Padang Padang Surf Camp
why_its_here: Padang Padang Surf Camp has coached surfers in Bingin since 2005, and its lead coach grew up surfing there.
best_for: Surfers who are progressing and want structured coaching at Bingin

name: PAK GULA
address: Jl. Pantai Bingin No.05, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
what_to_order: chicken satay
why_its_here: PAK GULA is a two-storey restaurant in Bingin from the team behind The Cashew Tree. Sharing plates include char siu pork bao, vegetable dumplings, chicken satay and braised beef curry. Downstairs is casual; upstairs is a low-lit dinner room with communal tables and a bar.
best_for: A shared dinner in Bingin
not_for: Walking in at dinner - booking is recommended

name: Pandawa Cliff Estate
why_its_here: At Pandawa Cliff Estate, a wellness spa in the Bukit, the eight treatments include Balinese massage, reflexology and a body scrub. Bookings are made on the estate's own website.
best_for: A Balinese massage or reflexology after a day walking the Bukit

name: Pantai Pandawa
why_its_here: A white-sand beach on the Bukit peninsula in Badung. You reach it on a road cut through the cliffs, and statues of the Pandawa brothers line the entrance.
best_for: Families and swimmers who want calmer water than the west-coast surf beaches

name: Papi Sapi
address: Uluwatu/Bukit
price_anchor: sapi penyet burger 140K (menu-bali, 2026-09-28; grill cuts priced by weight at the showcase)
what_to_order: premium grills; wagyu rib eye; picanha
why_its_here: A fire-driven neighbourhood grill on Jl. Labuansait in Pecatu (the Bukit), where guests pick cuts of meat, seafood and vegetables from a display chiller — priced by weight per 100 grams — to be cooked over live flames; open evenings only, with live music on Thursdays and DJs on other nights.
best_for: Meat lovers wanting a relaxed evening of pick-your-cut grilling, dinner and drinks in the Uluwatu area.
full_address: Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Piccolina
why_its_here: Hair comes first at this salon on Jl. Labuansait: precision cuts, colour, keratin and blow-dries to European standards. Manicures and massage are available too, and the space doubles as a small wine bottle shop.
best_for: An expert cut or colour for men or women

name: Piccolina Bali
what_to_order: Signature Foot Massage — 120K IDR.
why_its_here: Piccolina Bali is a beauty salon in the Bukit that takes bookings through Fresha. Among its 56 treatments are haircuts, head massage and a neck & shoulder treatment, and the Signature Foot Massage is 120K IDR.
best_for: A foot or head massage, booked on Fresha after a day of walking

name: Poggy Bali Surf School
why_its_here: A surf school based at Padang Padang beach. It coaches all levels across the Bukit's breaks, including Padang Padang, Bingin and Dreamland.
best_for: Coaching tailored to your level, moving between the Bukit's breaks

name: Professional Massage Uluwatu
what_to_order: Traditional Balinese Massage (60 min) — 400K IDR.
why_its_here: Professional Massage Uluwatu, in the Bukit, is a wellness spa with 12 treatments: hot stone, traditional massage and spa packages among them. A traditional Balinese massage is 400K IDR for an hour, booked on the spa's own website. Treatments run up to two hours.
best_for: A hot stone massage, or an hour of traditional Balinese massage

name: Raw Gym Uluwatu
why_its_here: Raw Gym's Uluwatu branch is an open-air warehouse-style gym with a boxing ring and a martial-arts space, on Jalan Raya Uluwatu. Coaches teach Muay Thai, boxing and BJJ alongside strength training, and membership is valid at the other Bali locations too.
best_for: Combat sports, or no-frills high-intensity training

name: Reform Pilates Bali
why_its_here: A reformer Pilates studio that opened in Bingin in 2023, then added a larger flagship near Suluban Beach with twelve reformers and a rooftop cafe. Group reformer classes run daily, alongside private sessions and duets, and class packs work at both locations.
best_for: Reformer Pilates regulars who want daily group classes or 1:1 sessions

name: Reform Pilates Bingin
why_its_here: A reformer pilates studio in Bingin, opened in 2023 by Abbey. Classes include Booty & Core, Body Blast and deep stretch. Pre- and post-natal reformer classes run for the first and second trimesters. Booking is online.
best_for: Reformer work close to Bingin beach

name: Reform+ Uluwatu
why_its_here: Reform+ is the second Reform Pilates location, in Uluwatu, running reformer classes that you book online.
best_for: Reformer pilates in Uluwatu

why_its_here: An hour of Balinese massage costs 200K IDR at Rika Beauty & Spa, a day spa in the Bukit. Its 22 treatments also include traditional massage and waxing, and you book by WhatsApp.
best_for: Booking as a couple, or an hour of Balinese massage
full_address: JI. Raya Uluwatu.75X, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali

name: Rose Petal
why_its_here: Hair, facials, lashes, brows, nails and body treatments under one roof, at a beauty centre on Jl. Labuansait with a lounge and a sunset terrace. Its colourists are trained in European and Asian techniques such as balayage and lived-in colour.
best_for: Hair colour or a fuller beauty day somewhere upmarket, with a lounge to linger in

name: Rose Petal Beauty Center
why_its_here: Facials, lashes and haircuts are among the 28 treatments at Rose Petal Beauty Center, a beauty salon in the Bukit. You book through Fresha.
best_for: A facial, booked on Fresha
full_address: Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu

why_its_here: The Cashew Tree's rotisserie in Pecatu slow-roasts meats and serves them with fresh sides and sauces.
best_for: A plate of roast meat after the beach

why_its_here: At salty face Bali, a day spa in the Bukit, the 38 treatments include facials, lashes and Balinese massage. A 60-minute Balinese massage costs 345K IDR, and booking is on the spa's own website.

name: Sean Spa Bali

name: Seed Bingin
address: Jl. Pantai Bingin, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: beef rendang; creme brulee; seasonal plates
why_its_here: A French-Asian farm-to-table restaurant set in a lush garden a couple of minutes' walk from Bingin Beach, using wood-fired cooking and herbs grown on-site; the kitchen is led by Chef Simon (formerly of his own restaurant in the French Alps), with a Wagyu beef rendang in a slow-cooked coconut sauce as the signature dish.
best_for: A relaxed garden dinner for couples or groups wanting fusion cooking away from the beach crowds.

best_for: A couple massage at the resort, or 50 minutes of reflexology

name: Shiki Spa
what_to_order: FOOT MASSAGE / REFLEXOLOGY (60 min) — 150K IDR.
why_its_here: Shiki Spa is a day spa in the Bukit with a long list: 77 treatments, among them waxing, lashes and manicures. An hour of foot massage or reflexology costs 150K IDR. The longest treatment runs two hours.
best_for: A foot massage when walking has worn you out, or lashes and waxing
full_address: Indah Resort, Ruko Plaza, Jl. Sahadewa Jl. Raya Uluwatu Pecatu No.17, Kompleks, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Single Fin
address: Pecatu / uluwatu bukit
price_anchor: nasi goreng single fin 135K incl. tax and service (eat & drinks menu, 2026-09-28)
what_to_order: pizza; tacos; sliders
why_its_here: A multi-level cliffside bar above Suluban (Blue Point) Beach in Uluwatu, looking straight onto the Uluwatu surf break, known for its sunset crowd and long-running Sunday Sessions with international DJs and live acts; it serves food through the day — pizzas, burgers, tacos and Indonesian dishes — but the draw is the deck, the view and the scene as much as the menu.
best_for: Sundowners and the Sunday (or Wednesday) party sessions — arrive well before 4:30pm for a spot at the cliff edge.
full_address: Pantai Suluban, Jl. Labuan Sait, Pecatu, Uluwatu, Kuta Selatan, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Six Senses Spa Uluwatu
why_its_here: Six Senses Uluwatu's destination spa has treatment rooms, a yoga pavilion and a gym. It uses the Ila product line and locally inspired rituals, and builds bespoke programmes around wellness and biomarker screening.
best_for: A wellness day of screening, yoga and treatments at a clifftop resort

name: Six Senses Uluwatu Fitness Centre
why_its_here: The resort gym at Six Senses Uluwatu is open 24 hours. Cardio and weight machines join functional training kit, with outdoor circuits on the clifftop grounds. The wellness area around it holds treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge, spa bath, sauna and steam room.
best_for: A round-the-clock gym without leaving the resort

name: Six Senses Uluwatu Pilates
why_its_here: Pilates at Six Senses Uluwatu runs in the same air-conditioned pavilion as the resort yoga and Pranayama programme, on the clifftop grounds above Pecatu.
best_for: Resort guests who want mat pilates to go with the yoga schedule

name: Six Senses Uluwatu Yoga Pavilion
why_its_here: An air-conditioned yoga pavilion at Six Senses Uluwatu. Daily meditation and an intro-to-yoga session, 30 minutes each, are included for resort guests. Longer 45 to 60 minute sessions, such as Yoga Nidra, traditional yoga and a yogic intestinal cleanse, cost extra.
best_for: Resort guests after a daily indoor practice out of the Bukit heat, with free short sessions and longer paid ones

name: Snowcat Bali USSR Cuisine
address: Jl. Raya Uluwatu No.93, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Pelmeni, olivier, draniki and herring under a fur coat come out of this post-Soviet kitchen on Jl. Raya Uluwatu in Ungasan. Portions are large, with homemade infusions to drink. It does delivery as well as dine-in and bookings.
best_for: Russian-speaking guests who want food from home

name: Sohamsa Ocean Estate
why_its_here: Sohamsa Ocean Estate in the Bukit runs a spa with four treatments, among them a Balinese massage, reflexology and a body scrub. Booking is on the estate's own website.
best_for: Reflexology when a day on foot has left your feet tired

name: Son of A Baker
address: Uluwatu/Bukit
what_to_order: artisanal bakes; Italian coffee; pumpkin-seed latte
why_its_here: An independent Italian-leaning coffee, bakery and art house on Jl. Labuansait in Pecatu, near Padang Padang beach, doing house-baked croissants, focaccia and piadina, hand-made pasta and grass-fed dairy, with a pumpkin-seed milk latte as its signature; open from 6am, it draws early surfers and a creative, plant-forward crowd.
best_for: An early breakfast or coffee-and-pastry stop for surfers and a relaxed brunch crowd around Padang Padang, with plenty of vegan and gluten-free options.
full_address: Uluwatu/Bukit

name: Spa at Mu
why_its_here: An open-air cliffside spa at Mu Bali resort that looks over Bingin beach and the Impossibles surf break. Massages are done al fresco with natural and organic oils, facing the ocean and a temple.
best_for: A scenic outdoor massage on the Bingin cliffs, for a couple or a surfer

name: Spa Shell
what_to_order: Balinese Massage (60 min) — 220K IDR.
why_its_here: Spa Shell is a Bukit spa with 18 treatments, including Balinese massage, deep tissue and reflexology. An hour of Balinese massage costs 220K IDR, and you book on the spa's own website.
best_for: A day of walking, then reflexology for your feet
full_address: Jl. Raya Uluwatu No.27x, Ungasan, Uluwatu, Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Spring Spa Bingin
why_its_here: Spring Spa Bingin is a spa in the Bukit with six treatments on its list, among them traditional massage, a facial and a foot massage.
best_for: A foot massage in Bingin when you have walked enough for the day
full_address: Jalan Padma Utara, Legian

name: Spring Spa Uluwatu
why_its_here: Treatment rooms, a Davines hair salon and mani-pedi stations make up this day spa on Jalan Labuan Sait. It uses brands such as CODAGE Paris and Davines.
best_for: Massage, facials, hair and nails on the same visit in central Uluwatu

name: Studio Fondue
why_its_here: A design-led Pilates studio in Uluwatu that teaches Reformer, Mat and Barre classes. A drop-in class starts from 250K IDR.
best_for: Pilates-goers after a design-led studio for reformer or mat sessions

address: Pecatu / uluwatu bukit

why_its_here: Busy Australian-style cafe with strong coffee and broad breakfast-to-dinner menu.
best_for: brunch after surf; quiet work cafe; just landed easy dinner
full_address: Jl. Labuansait, Uluwatu

name: Supernatural Wellbeing
why_its_here: Supernatural Wellbeing is a massage studio in the Bukit with four treatments, among them Swedish, aromatherapy and hot stone massage.
best_for: A Swedish massage in the Bukit

name: Supreme Indian Restaurant
what_to_order: butter chicken; chicken biryani; chicken tikka; tandoori chicken; gulab jamun
why_its_here: North and South Indian cooking on Jl. Raya Uluwatu in Ungasan, in an air-conditioned dining room with a bar. Tandoor dishes and curries share the menu with a broad vegetarian and vegan list.
best_for: A comfortable sit-down Indian dinner in Uluwatu, vegetarians included

name: Svaha Spa Bingin
why_its_here: A cliffside day spa above Bingin with ocean views, doing Balinese massage, scrubs and jacuzzi rituals. Its focus is sustainable and holistic.
best_for: An ocean-view treatment near Bingin and Impossibles, after a surf or a day on the beach

name: Svaha Spa Melasti
why_its_here: At Svaha Spa Melasti, a day spa in the Bukit, you can have a Balinese massage or a spa package. Its website takes bookings.
best_for: A spa package, or just a Balinese massage

name: The Asa Maia
why_its_here: An adults-only wellness retreat in Uluwatu with a small spa, contrast therapy, an infrared sauna and hot and cold plunge pools. It uses local and natural products.
best_for: Contrast therapy, yoga and a massage in one visit

name: The Asa Maia Fitness
why_its_here: The Asa Maia, a family-owned adults-only wellness retreat in Uluwatu opened in 2021, has its gym in the central pavilion. The kit: treadmill, power rack, barbell, kettlebells, dumbbells, slam balls, a stepper, a TRX system and a Pilates Cadillac. An infrared sauna is on site.
best_for: Strength training with real equipment during a structured wellness stay

name: The Asa Maia Pilates
why_its_here: Pilates runs daily at The Asa Maia in Uluwatu, with classes built around strength, balance and flexibility and adapted to each guest's level. A Pilates Cadillac is part of the retreat's gym equipment.
best_for: Retreat guests who want daily pilates as part of a structured programme, including work on the Cadillac

name: The Asa Maia Yoga
why_its_here: Daily yoga at The Asa Maia, in a shala on the top level of the central pavilion. Instructors teach Hatha, Yin and Vinyasa, adapted to each guest's level. SOMA breathwork is the retreat's own practice; Indonesian martial arts and Qi Gong are also taught.
best_for: Daily guided practice matched to your level, during a wellness stay in Uluwatu
not_for: A drop-in class on a fixed schedule: practice here is guided and matched to each guest's level

name: The Bvlgari Spa
why_its_here: Bvlgari Resort Bali's spa occupies a reconstructed antique Javanese joglo on the Uluwatu cliff, about 150m above the sea, with eight whirlpool treatment rooms. The Royal Lulur couples ritual is on the menu, and treatments can also be done by the beach.
best_for: Luxury travellers after a high-end ritual on the cliff or by the beach

name: The Cashew Tree
address: Jl. Pantai Bingin No.9, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: the soul bowl; corn fritters; quesadillas; fresh juices and smoothies; vegan cakes and desserts
why_its_here: A relaxed, vegetarian-leaning cafe set in a leafy open-air space near Bingin, serving wholesome all-day plates and hosting weekly live-music nights. It doubles as a social hub with regular Thursday music and a fitness/yoga community on site.
best_for: post-surf brunch near bingin; healthy plant-forward meal; laid-back live-music night; casual group hang
not_for: anyone wanting a formal, fine-dining or meat-forward dinner

what_to_order: Nail Gel Color Hand or Foot (60 min) — 350K IDR.
why_its_here: The Elysian is a wellness spa in the Bukit with 80 treatments, from facials and body scrubs to traditional massage, the longest treatment lasting three hours. Gel colour on hand or foot nails is 350K IDR for 60 minutes, and bookings go through WhatsApp.
best_for: Gel nails and a facial, or a treatment as a couple

name: The Istana Spa
why_its_here: The Istana Spa is a day spa in the Bukit with eight items on its list, an ice bath among them; the longest treatment runs three hours. You book on the spa's own website.
best_for: An ice bath at a Bukit day spa

name: The Istana Wellness Club
why_its_here: A clifftop meditation and biohacking centre in Uluwatu, open daily 07:00-21:00. Alongside the yoga programme it runs a whole-body cryotherapy chamber, saunas and a spa, and hosts 10-day silent retreats. Membership runs in one-month blocks, and biohacking slots are booked online in advance.
best_for: Cryotherapy and sauna-based recovery with a meditation programme, on the Bukit
not_for: A one-off day pass, because membership runs in one-month blocks

name: The Istana Yoga
why_its_here: The Istana's yoga programme on the Uluwatu cliffs has around 20 class formats, from Vinyasa and Qigong to Rebirthing Breathwork and Yoga Nidra. Instructors are internationally trained, teacher training runs in 200- and 300-hour formats, and drop-ins start from 150,000 IDR.
best_for: A wide range of styles and a route into teacher training, with the donation-based Sunday class as a low-cost way in

name: The Resting Koala
what_to_order: The Foot Release (60 min) — 210K IDR.
why_its_here: The Resting Koala, a day spa in the Bukit, has 20 treatments, including foot massage, Balinese massage and spa packages, the longest treatment lasting two hours. Its Foot Release is 210K IDR for 60 minutes, and bookings go through WhatsApp.
best_for: The Foot Release after a day of walking, or a Balinese massage
full_address: Jl. Tj. Simah No.34, Pecatu, Bali - Indonesia

name: The Spa
why_its_here: The Spa, a day spa in the Bukit, lists 30 treatments, including traditional massage, hot stone and spa packages. The longest treatment runs two hours. Booking is on its own website.
best_for: Hot stone or a spa package in the Bukit

name: The Space Bali
why_its_here: A community hub in the Bingin and Uluwatu area with two bamboo shalas upstairs and a coworking cafe downstairs. The daily schedule is broad: vinyasa, yin, mobility and surf-mobility classes, plus teacher trainings.
best_for: Digital nomads and longer-stay travellers who want daily classes and a base for work and yoga

name: The Temple Lodge
why_its_here: A family-run guesthouse set up for surf and yoga, on the Bingin clifftop above Impossibles and Bingin. Its clifftop shala holds daily yoga that outside guests can join, and the spa and healthy restaurant are on site.
best_for: Surfers and couples who want clifftop yoga built into their stay

name: The Ungasan
why_its_here: The Ungasan is a wellness spa in the Bukit; message it on WhatsApp to book a facial.
best_for: A facial in the Bukit

why_its_here: In-resort Indonesian dining room with polished service and strong special-occasion appeal.
best_for: date night special; special occasion; family early dinner
full_address: Pecatu / uluwatu bukit

name: The Wellness Spa
what_to_order: Foot Massage (60 min) — 605K IDR.
why_its_here: With 116 treatments, The Wellness Spa is a day spa in the Bukit that covers traditional massage, facials and waxing, with the longest treatment running four hours. A 60-minute foot massage is 605K IDR; book on the spa's own website.
best_for: A partner treatment, or waxing and a facial

name: The Yoga Rescue
why_its_here: A quiet garden studio between Ungasan and Jimbaran, away from the busier clifftop crowds. Daily classes cover Hatha, Vinyasa, Ashtanga, Yin and aerial, plus private sessions and workshops.
best_for: Locals and repeat visitors after an unpretentious daily class near Ungasan

name: Tropical Temptation - Adult Only Beach Club
address: Ungasan / uluwatu bukit
why_its_here: An adults-only beach club on Melasti Beach in Uluwatu, built around a pool and daybeds with music and ocean views, open from midday into the evening.
best_for: sunset drinks view; group dinner share; special occasion
full_address: Ungasan / uluwatu bukit

name: Ula Cafe
address: Jl. Pantai Balangan, Ungasan, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361, Indonesia
why_its_here: Chef Mags builds the menu from scratch at Ula Cafe on Jl. Pantai Balangan and keeps separate breakfast and mains lists. There are woven textures, ocean air and vinyl in the background, plus wifi and power outlets throughout.
best_for: A slow breakfast with a laptop
not_for: A weekend evening - it closes at 16:00 on Saturday and Sunday

name: ULU Active & Recovery
why_its_here: An open-air fitness and recovery centre in Uluwatu, with a cafe. The training side covers strength, HIIT, yoga, Pilates and mobility, in functional training and group classes. The recovery zone has a sauna and steam rooms as well as hot-and-cold plunge pools.
best_for: Training and structured recovery in one visit

name: ULU ARTISAN — Ungasan
address: Uluwatu/Bukit
what_to_order: bagels; pancakes; brunch plates
why_its_here: An all-day artisan bakery and cafe on Jalan Raya Uluwatu in Ungasan, part of the local Artisan group, known for handcrafted sourdough, pastries and brunch by day, then turning to wood-fired sourdough pizza and southern Italian plates with craft cocktails and wine from early evening.
best_for: Digital nomads and travellers wanting a laptop-friendly brunch and good coffee that carries into a relaxed casual dinner.
full_address: Uluwatu/Bukit

name: Ulu Fishmarket
address: Jl. Labuansait No.10, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: sashimi trio; tuna tataki; miso ramen
why_its_here: A casual open-air seafood restaurant on Jl. Labuansait in Pecatu, near Bingin, modelled on Maui's Paia Fish Market and serving a Hawaiian-Japanese-Peruvian fusion of fresh catch, poke, sushi, ceviche and fish burgers in a tropical garden setting.
best_for: Relaxed group dinners and casual seafood lunches for surfers and travellers staying around Bingin and Padang Padang.
full_address: Jl. Labuansait No.10, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Ulu Garden
address: Uluwatu/Bukit
what_to_order: miso gnocchi; ulu fresh rolls; rice bowl
why_its_here: A tropical-garden restaurant tucked off Jalan Pantai Padang-Padang in Pecatu, part of the Ulu Tribe hospitality complex, serving a contemporary take on Indonesian cooking with modern-European and healthy-cafe touches; known for its lush, string-lit garden with nightly live music and Balinese dance and blessing rituals.
best_for: Groups, couples and families wanting a relaxed evening of garden dining with live music, and a rare kid-friendly option in the Bukit.
full_address: Jl. Pantai Padang-Padang, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: ULU Yoga Bali
why_its_here: A yoga school in a modern, air-conditioned ocean-view shala on Jl. Pantai Cemongkak in Pecatu, a few minutes inland from Bingin and Dreamland. It runs Yoga Alliance 200/300-hour and aerial teacher trainings alongside multi-style drop-in classes.
best_for: Teacher training, or structured multi-style practice that includes aerial and acro

name: Uluwatu Collective
why_its_here: At Uluwatu Collective, CrossFit, Metcon, HIIT, weightlifting, functional training and yoga run as group classes. The gym is high-ceilinged and open-air, above Pepito Express on Jl. Raya Uluwatu. Access is sold daily, weekly, monthly or yearly, and a month is 1,450,000 IDR.
best_for: Group classes rather than a solo gym floor
not_for: An evening session - it closes at 19:00

name: Uluwatu Custom Motorbike

what_to_order: Honda PCX 160 Maxi Scooter — 200K IDR per day.
why_its_here: Vehicle rental in the Bukit. The published fleet covers motorbikes and scooters. Honda PCX 160 Maxi Scooter starts at 200K IDR per day. Delivery to your villa or hotel is offered. Booking is by WhatsApp.
best_for: A delivery straight to your villa or hotel; a short self-drive rental, not a long-distance trip.

name: Vela Spa
why_its_here: An intimate spa at The Ungasan Clifftop Resort, with treatment rooms that look out over the Indian Ocean. Treatments include Balinese massage, scrubs and deep-tissue work.

name: WAATU
address: Uluwatu/Bukit

why_its_here: A clifftop yakitori and open-flame grill restaurant at The Ungasan Clifftop Resort in Uluwatu, led by Australian chef James Viles, where everything is cooked over coals with no gas or electricity; the share-style menu runs from woodfired mortadella flatbread and yakitori skewers to pork-and-scallop fried rice, with lawn and cliff-edge views over the Indian Ocean.
best_for: Dinner for couples or groups who want live-fire, produce-driven sharing plates with a clifftop ocean view; reservations recommended.

why_its_here: A no-frills local warung near Bingin and Pecatu, popular with surf instructors and resort staff for cheap, freshly cooked Indonesian plates and a well-regarded house sambal.
best_for: a cheap post-surf refuel; travellers wanting an unfussy authentic local meal; takeaway

best_for: budget mixed-rice plates; vegans and vegetarians; groups wanting to customise plates
not_for: diners after à-la-carte fine dining or a quiet atmosphere

why_its_here: An inexpensive Ungasan sit-down warung doing seafood and grilled plates in generous portions, open through lunch and dinner.

best_for: Foot reflexology after a long day on foot
full_address: WinBali Spa, Uluwatu

what_to_order: Nasi campur (mixed rice plate); tempeh and tofu dishes; vegetable curries; grilled or fried chicken sides
why_its_here: One of the Bukit's original cheap-eats warungs, open well over two decades on the Labuansait strip, feeding surfers and travellers a pick-your-own mixed-rice plate.
best_for: a quick, cheap local lunch mid-explore; vegetarians and vegans; repeat casual meals
not_for: diners wanting a polished sit-down restaurant or table service

name: YinSide Yoga
why_its_here: Yin Yoga is the focus of this small studio on Jl. Pantai Bingin: classes, workshops, retreats and 50-hour yin teacher trainings. Its shop sells plant-based yoga wear and props, made locally.
best_for: Slow, restorative yin practice and sustainable yoga gear

name: Yoga @ The Istana
why_its_here: A clifftop yoga studio with ocean views on Jl. Pantai Suluban, home to a resident yoga school and classes led by visiting teachers. Its wellness spa has a sauna, steam and a cold plunge.
best_for: Cliff-edge classes combined with spa and cold-plunge recovery

name: Yoga Searcher Bali
why_its_here: A yoga-centred eco-lodge with recycled-wood villas around a pool, on Jl. Labuan Sait near Padang Padang and Suluban. There's yoga every day, a plant-forward restaurant and a spa, all set up for retreat-style stays.
best_for: An all-in-one yoga retreat stay near the Suluban surf beaches

name: YUKI Uluwatu
address: Pecatu / uluwatu bukit
what_to_order: wagyu sando; tuna tartare; charcoal grill plates
why_its_here: A design-forward modern Japanese izakaya in Uluwatu, serving sushi and grilled plates with sake and cocktails, liveliest as an evening dinner-and-drinks spot.
best_for: date night special; group dinner share; special occasion
full_address: Jl. Labuansait, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Selatan, Kabupaten Badung, Bali

name: Zahra Spa Uluwatu
what_to_order: Child Body Massage (60 min) — 245K IDR.
why_its_here: Zahra Spa Uluwatu is a spa in the Bukit with 22 treatments, from traditional and Balinese massage to a neck & shoulder treatment. They run up to two hours. A one-hour body massage for a child costs 245K IDR, booked on the spa's own website.
best_for: A family visit, with a body massage for the child

name: Zali at Uluwatu
address: Jalan Pantai Labuan Sait, Suluban, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361
what_to_order: samke harra
why_its_here: Modern Lebanese/Mediterranean sharing restaurant with family-friendly all-day positioning.
best_for: group dinner share; family early dinner; date night special
full_address: Jalan Pantai Labuan Sait, Suluban, Pecatu, Kec. Kuta Sel., Kabupaten Badung, Bali 80361

name: Zando Fight Camp Uluwatu
why_its_here: Zando Fight Camp is a Muay Thai gym in Ungasan running group and private sessions, from beginner technique to advanced, with pad work and conditioning. A drop-in costs 150,000 IDR and a month 1,600,000.
best_for: Muay Thai with hands-on pad work
not_for: A Sunday session - the gym is closed
